# Launch teal_neue from the project folder (RStudio "Run App", Posit Connect, ...).
# With the package installed you can simply call teal.neue::run_app().
#
# Settings (see ?teal_neue_options), e.g.:
#   options(teal_neue.data_source = "synthetic", teal_neue.synthetic = list(N = 200, seed = 7))
#   options(teal_neue.data_source = "parquet", teal_neue.parquet_dir = "path/to/adam")
#   options(teal_neue.color_mode = "dark")   # default colour mode ("light"; "auto" follows the OS)
#   options(teal_neue.style = FALSE)         # plain teal look of the source templates

pkgload::load_all(export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
teal.neue::run_app()

Package: teal.neue
Title: Modernised Clinical Trial Analysis App Built on 'teal'
Version: 0.2.0
Authors@R: c(
    person("Tulio", "Author", email = "tulio@example.com", role = c("aut", "cre")),
    person("The Inter Project Authors", role = "cph",
           comment = "Inter font (SIL Open Font License 1.1)"),
    person("The JetBrains Mono Project Authors", role = "cph",
           comment = "JetBrains Mono font (SIL Open Font License 1.1)")
    )
Description: 'teal_neue' combines the exploratory, safety and efficacy
    'teal.gallery' templates into a single 'teal' application for clinical
    trial data in CDISC ADaM format, layered on top of the standard 'teal'
    theme so the app stays recognisably 'teal': a command bar that reaches
    every module and output, a breadcrumb, deep links and browser history,
    keyboard shortcuts, plot and table tools (viewer, copy, download), pins
    with visual comparison of plot versions, a calm "instrument" look with
    light and dark palettes, and cleaner plot defaults. A TLG Catalog
    section reproduces every table, listing and graph of the 'TLG Catalog'
    on the filtered data, with reproducible code. A cached data pipeline (ingestion,
    pre-processing, caching) reads the synthetic datasets bundled with
    'random.cdisc.data', freshly generated synthetic data with configurable
    size and seed, or ADaM parquet files. Every data source is checked
    against a data contract, and each analysis starts with the population of
    its source template (safety or intent-to-treat).

name: NAMESPACE
NEWS.md
content:
# teal.neue 0.2.0

A modernised take on the app: same structure, modules and analyses, with an
interactive layer (command bar, breadcrumb, deep links, shortcuts, plot and
table tools, pins with visual comparison), a new look ("Instrument"), a fixed
dark mode, faster self-contained loading and a new TLG Catalog tab. Renamed from *lumen* to **teal_neue** (R package
`teal.neue`; R package names cannot contain `_`).

## TLG Catalog

* New **TLG Catalog** tab next to Data Table with every output of the TLG
  Catalog (stable): 87 tables, 29 listings and 19 graphs, one page per topic
  (16 pages). Each page has an index column with a searchable,
  keyboard-navigable list of the outputs (Tables / Listings / Graphs
  sections, IDs in mono) and the output sheet with its title and actions.
  Every output is also reachable from the command bar and has its own link.
* Outputs run on the app's filtered data through teal's `eval_code()`, so
  "Show R code" gives the complete, reproducible code; each output links to
  its catalog page. Results are cached per output until the filters change.
* Outputs needing datasets the app does not load use the random.cdisc.data
  examples restricted to the filtered patients (`tlg_example_data()`).
* A failing output (or a missing package, e.g. *rbmi* for RBMIT01) shows a
  clear message with the code instead of breaking the page.

## Breaking changes (rename)

* Package `lumen` -> `teal.neue`; project file `teal_neue.Rproj`.
* Functions: `lumen_app()` -> `teal_neue_app()`, `load_lumen_data()` ->
  `load_teal_neue_data()`, `build_lumen_teal_data()` -> `build_teal_neue_data()`,
  `lumen_clear_cache()` -> `teal_neue_clear_cache()`, `lumen_join_keys()` ->
  `teal_neue_join_keys()`. `run_app()` and the pipeline functions keep their names.
* Options: `lumen.*` -> `teal_neue.*` (see `?teal_neue_options`).
* Disk cache: `teal_neue_adam.rds` in `tools::R_user_dir("teal.neue", "cache")`.
  The old cache (`tools::R_user_dir("lumen", "cache")`) is no longer used and
  can be deleted.

## Interaction

teal_neue adds an interactive layer over teal's unchanged structure (nothing
is moved; every module works as before, with or without it):

* **Command bar** (`Ctrl+K` / `Cmd+K`, or `/`, or the search field in the
  header): fuzzy search over every module (with its full path, e.g.
  *Safety Analysis / Adverse Events / AE Summary*), all 135 TLG Catalog
  outputs (by ID or title, e.g. `aet02` or `ae grade`) and every action.
  Recent views come first, then *Where to?*: every module in its category
  and sub-group, as cards nested like the menus (each category with its
  tint); typing switches to ranked results. Scopes (All, Where to?, TLG
  outputs, Actions; `Tab` cycles them) and prefixes (`>` actions, `#` outputs); `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter`
  opens the result in a new browser tab. Deeply nested modules are one
  search away instead of two or three menus.
* **Where am I**: a breadcrumb of the current module (and TLG output) in the
  header; each crumb lists its group's modules. The browser tab shows the
  module name.
* **Deep links and history**: every view has its own address
  (`#/safety-analysis/adverse-events/ae-summary`, also
  `#/tlg-catalog/adverse-events/aet02`), so views can be bookmarked and
  shared, and the browser's back and forward buttons move between views.
* **Home page**: the App Info page opens with *Study at a glance*. The logo
  and the app name in the header lead home (so does `H`).
  * *Study at a glance*: key figures (subjects, median age, female share,
    serious adverse events, median overall survival, response rate), each
    with a small chart, and three widgets: **Demographics** (age histogram
    with the median, median age by arm, sex, race), **Safety** (subjects with
    any, serious, grade 3 or higher, withdrawal-causing adverse events and
    deaths, and the most frequent adverse events, as one dot per arm on a
    common scale) and **Efficacy** (Kaplan-Meier curves of overall survival
    with a crosshair that reads survival by arm at any time, medians by arm,
    response rates with 95% Wilson intervals). Each arm has one colour
    everywhere (placebo in grey); pointing at an arm highlights it across
    all widgets, clicking its chip keeps it highlighted. Each widget links to
    the module that goes into detail. The figures describe the whole study
    (safety or intent-to-treat population, before any filter) and are
    computed once when the app is built (`R/overview.R`); parts whose data
    are missing are left out.
  * A *Where to?* button opens the command bar on every module, grouped as
    in the menus.
* **Keyboard shortcuts** (`?` shows them all): `H` home, `[` / `]` previous
  / next module, `T` light / dark, `A` appearance, `D` spacing, `F` focus mode, `\` filter
  panel, `C` "Show R code", `P` pins, `L` copy a link to this view.
* **Plot tools** (hover a plot): *Expand* into a full-screen viewer (zoom at
  the pointer with the wheel, drag to pan, `0` fit, `1` actual size),
  *Pin*, *Compare*, *Copy* (image to the clipboard) and *PNG* download.
  Clicking a plot opens the viewer too, except on plots that use clicks
  themselves (brushing).
* **Table tools** (hover a table): *Copy* for Excel (the layout is kept),
  *CSV* download, *Pin*.
* **Pins and comparison**: pin a plot, change a filter, then *Compare*: the
  viewer shows the pinned and the current plot with a swipe divider, side
  by side, or as a **difference** (unchanged pixels turn white, what changed
  keeps its colour). Pins are kept in a tray for the session (`P`); any two
  can be compared.
* **Status**: a progress line while the server computes (only after 180 ms, so
  fast updates do not flicker), an amber status dot, and the duration of the
  last update next to the data source and number of subjects.
* **Appearance** (the sliders button in the header, or `A`): colour mode
  (light, dark, or following the system), text size (S, M, L, XL), spacing
  (compact, comfortable, roomy; `D` cycles it), accent (by section, or one of
  teal, ocean, iris, graphite for the whole app), corners (soft or crisp),
  contrast (standard or high), canvas (dot grid or plain) and motion.
  Remembered by the browser and applied before the first paint.
* **Section tints**: each main category has its own quiet accent: teal for the
  general pages, blue for Exploratory, terracotta for Safety, green for
  Efficacy, violet for the TLG Catalog. The selected tab, buttons, focus
  rings, selections and a breath of the canvas take it, so moving between
  categories is felt without being loud; the breadcrumb, the *Where to?*
  cards and the home widgets carry the same colour marks. The brand stays
  teal.
* **Focus mode**: the header and footer step aside for the module.
* Everything is keyboard accessible (the command bar is an ARIA combobox,
  dialogs trap focus and return it) and respects reduced motion.

## Look and feel

"Instrument": a look for people who read clinical data all day.

* White, hairline-ruled panels on a faint dot-grid canvas (lab-notebook
  paper). Colour only where it means something: teal for where you are and
  what acts, amber for work in progress.
* Two typefaces with distinct jobs: the system font (SF Pro on Apple
  devices, no download) or Inter for reading; JetBrains Mono for machine
  facts (dataset and variable names such as `ADSL · AGE` in the filter
  cards, output IDs, counts, timings, keys, section labels).
* Top-level tabs are a rail with a sliding teal indicator; nested tabs are a
  compact segmented control; menus, dialogs and notifications are crisp
  sheets; code is shown on an ink "terminal" in both modes.
* New app icon: a survival (Kaplan-Meier) step curve on teal.
* Fast by construction: no blur, no background images, no ambient animation;
  transitions are 120-260 ms and only on transform, opacity and colour.
  `options(teal_neue.motion = FALSE)` turns animations off.
* Light mode is the default (`teal_neue.color_mode = "light"`).
* The look is a CSS layer over teal's default Bootstrap 5 theme (it redefines
  Bootstrap's CSS variables) plus one script, so the app stays recognisably
  teal and needs no Sass compilation at start-up.
* `options(teal_neue.style = FALSE)` restores the plain teal look (and turns
  the interactive layer off).

## Dark mode

* New dark palette: an instrument panel at night: ink-blue blacks, hairlines
  that stay visible, a luminous teal accent (`#2cc5b4`) and amber for work in
  progress.
* Switching modes is a circular reveal from the toggle (View Transitions; an
  instant switch in browsers without them).
* Fixed widgets that kept light-mode colours in dark mode: neutral/light/outline
  buttons, `.bg-light`/`.bg-white` surfaces, `.text-dark`, `.table-light`,
  selectize inputs and dropdowns, native selects, DataTables (rows, paging,
  search), plotly axis text (filter panel histograms), notifications,
  tooltips.
* Plots (rendered on the server as light images) stay white "paper" with a
  hairline frame and slightly dimmed glare; their colours stay identical to the
  reproducible R code.
* The colour mode starts light by default (`teal_neue.color_mode`: `"light"`,
  `"dark"` or `"auto"` to follow the operating system); dark mode is applied
  before the first paint (no white flash), and the user's choice is remembered
  by the browser.
* Works around a bslib toggle bug that wrote `data-bs-theme="undefined"` when the
  page started in light mode, which made the first click do nothing.

## Plots

* A cleaner, editorial look for every ggplot2 module through teal's
  `teal.ggplot2_args` option (`teal_neue_ggplot2_args()`), on top of whichever
  ggplot2 theme the user picks: large left-aligned bold titles; a graded ink
  scale (titles, axis and legend titles, axis labels, captions); facet labels
  as bold left-aligned headings instead of grey strips; no tick marks or minor
  grid lines; plain legend keys; more room between panels and around the
  plot. They appear in "Show R code", so reproduced plots match the app. Data
  colours (the NEST palette) are unchanged. Set the option yourself to
  override it.
* Exploratory plot modules default to `theme_minimal()` instead of the grey
  `theme_gray()` (option `teal_neue.ggtheme`; users can still change it per
  module). The theme is only passed to modules whose installed version
  supports it.
* Scatterplot: smaller, slightly transparent points (`size = 2.5`, `alpha = 0.8`)
  so overlapping subjects stay visible.
* Plots can be expanded, pinned, compared (swipe, side by side, difference),
  copied and downloaded from the app (see "Interaction").

## Loading

* **Instant relaunch**: the built app is kept for the R session; `run_app()`
  with the same settings and data reuses it (a fraction of a second instead
  of a full build). `options(teal_neue.app_cache = FALSE)` turns this off;
  `teal_neue_clear_cache()` forgets it.
* **Instant reloads and new sessions**: teal builds the page (the interface
  of every module) on each browser request; teal_neue keeps the first page
  and serves it again (requests with a query string, e.g. a bookmark, are
  still built afresh).
* The TLG Catalog registry is built once per session (it was built several
  times per app build).
* The script is loaded with `defer`, so it never delays the first paint;
  settings that affect the look (colour mode, appearance) are applied by a
  tiny inline script before the first paint.
* The build reports where its time goes, e.g. `App built in 2.1s (data 0.3s,
  modules 1.2s, overview 0.1s, teal 0.5s)`, and the status in the header
  shows how long the app took to be ready in the browser (`ready 1.8 s`).
* No third-party requests: the favicon (previously fetched from GitHub on
  every page load) is inlined, and fonts and scripts are served by the app
  itself, which also suits offline and firewalled deployments.
* No UI font download at all on Apple devices (system font); elsewhere one
  92 KB Inter file (every weight) instead of two Open Sans files, plus
  JetBrains Mono (2 x 32 KB) for machine facts. The italic face is
  deliberately not shipped, so icon tags do not trigger an extra download.
* The new look costs no Sass compilation (about 0.75 s per cold start for a
  custom `bslib::bs_theme()`): bslib's precompiled default theme is kept.
* The interactive layer is one dependency-free script; it does its work on
  demand (the command bar is built the first time it opens).

# lumen 0.1.0

* First release as an R package.
* Combines the exploratory, safety and efficacy teal.gallery templates in one
  app, with module-specific filters (safety population for safety modules,
  intent-to-treat for efficacy modules) and a dark mode toggle.
* Data pipeline `ingest_adam()` -> `validate_adam()` -> `preprocess_adam()`
  with session memory and disk caches (`load_lumen_data()`).
* Data sources: bundled *random.cdisc.data* datasets, freshly generated
  synthetic data (`N`, `seed`, per-dataset arguments) and ADaM parquet files
  (`export_adam_parquet()` writes them).
* Data contract (`adam_contract()`) and checks of the values the app
  pre-selects (`check_app_defaults()`).
* Readable, illustrative MedDRA-style adverse event names (`ae_dictionary()`).
* Reproducible "Show R code": calls `lumen::load_lumen_data()` with the
  resolved data-source settings.
* Fix: `ADLBPCA` now has join keys, so the ADSL filters (sex, age) also apply
  to the PCA module (the exploratory template silently lacked them).

name: R/ae_dictionary.R
content:
# ADAE: readable adverse event names.
#
# {random.cdisc.data} uses placeholder codes for the MedDRA-style hierarchy:
#   AESOC "cl A"  > AEBODSYS "cl A.1" > AEHLGT "hlgt A.1.1" > AEHLT "hlt A.1.1.1"
#   > AEDECOD "dcd A.1.1.1.1" (AELLT "llt ...", AETERM "trm ..." share the code)
# The depth of the code identifies the level, so one dictionary covers all
# levels. Names follow MedDRA spelling (e.g. "Diarrhoea"). Every code maps to a
# distinct name within its level, so no AE groups are merged and counts are
# unchanged. NOTE: the grades/seriousness stay as simulated by
# random.cdisc.data; the names are illustrative, not clinically matched.

#' Adverse event dictionary and decoding
#'
#' 'random.cdisc.data' uses placeholder codes for the MedDRA-style hierarchy:
#' `AESOC "cl A"` > `AEBODSYS "cl A.1"` > `AEHLGT "hlgt A.1.1"` >
#' `AEHLT "hlt A.1.1.1"` > `AEDECOD "dcd A.1.1.1.1"` (`AELLT "llt ..."` and
#' `AETERM "trm ..."` share the code). `ae_dictionary()` maps each code to an
#' illustrative MedDRA-style name (the code depth gives the level);
#' `decode_ae_terms()` applies it to the AE term columns and to the AESI basket
#' names (`SMQ01NAM`, `SMQ02NAM`, `CQ01NAM`).
#'
#' Every code maps to a distinct name within its level, so no AE groups are
#' merged and counts are unchanged. Values that are not codes (e.g. real
#' MedDRA terms) are left alone; codes missing from the dictionary are kept and
#' reported in a warning.
#'
#' @param adae An ADAE data.frame.
#' @return `ae_dictionary()`: named character vector (code -> name).
#'   `decode_ae_terms()`: `adae` with decoded values (same rows, labels kept).
#' @examples
#' head(ae_dictionary())
#' decode_ae_terms(data.frame(AEDECOD = c("dcd A.1.1.1.1", "dcd D.1.1.4.2")))
#' @export
ae_dictionary <- function() {
  c(
    # AESOC (depth 1)
    "A" = "Gastrointestinal disorders",
    "B" = "Cardiovascular disorders",
    "C" = "Infections and immune system disorders",
    "D" = "Nervous system and general disorders",
    # AEBODSYS (depth 2)
    "A.1" = "Gastrointestinal disorders",
    "B.1" = "Cardiac disorders",
    "B.2" = "Vascular disorders",
    "C.1" = "Infections and infestations",
    "C.2" = "Immune system disorders",
    "D.1" = "Nervous system disorders",
    "D.2" = "General disorders and administration site conditions",
    # AEHLGT (depth 3)
    "A.1.1" = "Gastrointestinal signs and symptoms",
    "B.1.1" = "Coronary artery disorders",
    "B.2.1" = "Vascular hypertensive disorders",
    "B.2.2" = "Decreased and nonspecific blood pressure disorders and shock",
    "C.1.1" = "Infections - pathogen unspecified",
    "C.2.1" = "Allergic conditions",
    "D.1.1" = "Central nervous system disorders",
    "D.2.1" = "General system disorders NEC",
    # AEHLT (depth 4)
    "A.1.1.1" = "Gastrointestinal signs and symptoms NEC",
    "B.1.1.1" = "Ischaemic coronary artery disorders",
    "B.2.1.2" = "Vascular hypertensive disorders NEC",
    "B.2.2.3" = "Vascular hypotensive disorders",
    "C.1.1.1" = "Lower respiratory tract and lung infections",
    "C.2.1.2" = "Allergic conditions NEC",
    "D.1.1.1" = "Central nervous system haemorrhages and cerebrovascular accidents",
    "D.1.1.4" = "Headaches NEC",
    "D.2.1.5" = "Asthenic conditions",
    # AEDECOD / AELLT / AETERM (depth 5)
    "A.1.1.1.1" = "Diarrhoea",
    "A.1.1.1.2" = "Nausea",
    "B.1.1.1.1" = "Myocardial infarction",
    "B.2.1.2.1" = "Hypertension",
    "B.2.2.3.1" = "Hypotension",
    "C.1.1.1.3" = "Pneumonia",
    "C.2.1.2.1" = "Hypersensitivity",
    "D.1.1.1.1" = "Cerebrovascular accident",
    "D.1.1.4.2" = "Headache",
    "D.2.1.5.3" = "Fatigue"
  )
}

#' @noRd
ae_code_pattern <- "^(cl|hlgt|hlt|llt|dcd|trm) ([A-Z](\\.[0-9]+)*)$"

# Whole-value codes, e.g. "dcd A.1.1.1.1" -> "Diarrhoea"
#' @noRd
decode_ae_values <- function(x, dict = ae_dictionary()) {
  code <- sub(ae_code_pattern, "\\2", x)
  code[!grepl(ae_code_pattern, x)] <- NA_character_
  out <- unname(dict[code])
  ifelse(is.na(out), x, out)
}

# Codes embedded in text, e.g. "C.1.1.1.3/B.2.2.3.1 AESI" -> "Pneumonia/Hypotension AESI"
#' @noRd
decode_ae_text <- function(x, dict = ae_dictionary()) {
  pt <- dict[lengths(strsplit(names(dict), ".", fixed = TRUE)) == 5]
  for (code in names(pt)) {
    x <- gsub(
      sprintf("(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])%s(?![0-9.])", gsub(".", "\\.", code, fixed = TRUE)),
      pt[[code]], x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
  }
  x
}

# Recode a character/factor column via its unique values, keeping attributes (labels)
#' @noRd
recode_column <- function(x, fun) {
  if (is.factor(x)) {
    levels(x) <- fun(levels(x))
  } else if (is.character(x)) {
    u <- unique(x)
    x[] <- unname(stats::setNames(fun(u), u)[x])
  }
  x
}

#' @rdname ae_dictionary
#' @export
decode_ae_terms <- function(adae) {
  term_cols <- intersect(c("AETERM", "AELLT", "AEDECOD", "AEHLT", "AEHLGT", "AEBODSYS", "AESOC"), names(adae))
  text_cols <- intersect(c("SMQ01NAM", "SMQ02NAM", "CQ01NAM"), names(adae))
  for (col in term_cols) adae[[col]] <- recode_column(adae[[col]], decode_ae_values)
  for (col in text_cols) adae[[col]] <- recode_column(adae[[col]], decode_ae_text)

  # Anything still coded is missing from ae_dictionary(): keep it, but say so
  leftover <- unique(unlist(lapply(term_cols, function(col) {
    v <- unique(as.character(adae[[col]]))
    v[!is.na(v) & grepl(ae_code_pattern, v)]
  })))
  if (length(leftover)) {
    warning("[teal_neue] AE codes without a name in ae_dictionary() (left unchanged): ", toString(leftover), call. = FALSE)
  }
  adae
}

name: R/app_filters.R
content:
# Module-specific filters: each module starts with the population of its
# source template.
#   all modules      : ADSL SEX, ADSL AGE
#   Safety modules   : + SAFFL == "Y", ADLB/ADEX/ADEG AVAL
#   Efficacy modules : + ITTFL == "Y"

#' Filter set for the app
#' @param modules The app's modules (see teal_neue_modules()).
#' @noRd
teal_neue_filters <- function(modules) {
  group <- function(label) {
    Filter(function(x) identical(x$label, label), modules$children)[[1]]
  }
  global_filter_ids <- c("ADSL SEX", "ADSL AGE")
  safety_filter_ids <- c("ADSL SAFFL", "ADLB AVAL", "ADEX AVAL", "ADEG AVAL")
  efficacy_filter_ids <- c("ADSL ITTFL")

  teal::teal_slices(
    count_type = "all",
    # shared by every module (all three source apps)
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADSL", varname = "SEX", id = "ADSL SEX"),
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADSL", varname = "AGE", id = "ADSL AGE"),
    # safety-evaluable population + default safety filters
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADSL", varname = "SAFFL", selected = "Y", id = "ADSL SAFFL"),
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADLB", varname = "AVAL", id = "ADLB AVAL"),
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADEX", varname = "AVAL", id = "ADEX AVAL"),
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADEG", varname = "AVAL", id = "ADEG AVAL"),
    # intent-to-treat population
    teal.slice::teal_slice(dataname = "ADSL", varname = "ITTFL", selected = "Y", id = "ADSL ITTFL"),
    module_specific = TRUE,
    mapping = c(
      list(global_filters = global_filter_ids),
      sapply(leaf_labels(group("Safety Analysis")), function(x) safety_filter_ids, simplify = FALSE),
      sapply(leaf_labels(group("Efficacy Analysis")), function(x) efficacy_filter_ids, simplify = FALSE)
    )
  )
}

# Module configuration: the three teal.gallery templates (inst/templates/)
# as tab groups, plus the shared pages. Module calls are kept as in the
# templates; see the NOTE comments for the intentional changes.
#
# The exploratory plot modules are created through teal_neue_plot_module()
# (R/plot_theme.R), which only adds the app's default ggplot2 theme
# (option teal_neue.ggtheme) to modules that support it.

#' All app modules
#' @param data The app's `teal_data` (see [build_teal_neue_data()]).
#' @noRd
teal_neue_modules <- function(data) {
  source <- data[[".teal_neue"]]$source
  all_modules <- modules(
    module_app_info(source),
    tm_data_table("Data Table"),
    modules_tlg_catalog(datanames = names(data)),
    tm_variable_browser("Variable Browser"),
    modules_exploratory(teal_neue_file_viewer_paths(source)),
    modules_safety(data),
    modules_efficacy(data)
  )
  labels <- leaf_labels(all_modules)
  if (anyDuplicated(labels)) {
    stop("Module labels must be unique: ", toString(unique(labels[duplicated(labels)])), call. = FALSE)
  }
  all_modules
}

#' Front page
#' @noRd
module_app_info <- function(teal_neue_source) {
  tm_front_page(
    label = "App Info",
    header_text = c(
      "About this app" = paste(
        "teal_neue brings together exploratory, safety and efficacy analyses of a clinical trial in one place.",
        "Use the tabs to move between sections; each analysis opens with the population used in its",
        "source template (safety population for Safety, intent-to-treat population for Efficacy).",
        "The TLG Catalog tab reproduces every table, listing and graph of the TLG Catalog on the filtered data, one page per topic.",
        "Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on a Mac) anywhere to jump to any module or TLG output by name, and ? to see every keyboard shortcut.",
        "Click the logo (or press H) to come back here: Study at a glance summarises the whole study by arm, before any filter.",
        "Hover a plot or a table for its tools (expand, pin for comparison, copy, download).",
        "The sun/moon button in the header switches between light and dark mode; your browser remembers the choice."
      ),
      "Info about input data source" = switch(teal_neue_source$source,
        bundled = paste(
          "This app uses the synthetic CDISC ADaM datasets bundled with the `random.cdisc.data` R package.",
          "Adverse event terms were mapped from placeholder codes to illustrative MedDRA-style names."
        ),
        synthetic = paste0(
          "This app uses synthetic CDISC ADaM datasets freshly generated with the `random.cdisc.data` R package ",
          "(", teal_neue_source$synthetic$N, " subjects, seed ", teal_neue_source$synthetic$seed, "). ",
          "Adverse event terms were mapped from placeholder codes to illustrative MedDRA-style names."
        ),
        parquet = paste0("This app uses ADaM datasets read from the parquet files in `", teal_neue_source$parquet_dir, "`.")
      )
    ),
    tables = list(
      `App sections` = data.frame(
        Section = c("TLG Catalog", "Exploratory Analysis", "Safety Analysis", "Efficacy Analysis"),
        `Default population` = c(
          "As in the TLG Catalog (safety or intent-to-treat population, per output)",
          "All subjects", "Safety population (SAFFL = Y)", "Intent-to-treat (ITTFL = Y)"
        ),
        Datasets = c(
          "All datasets, plus ADPC, ADPP, ADAB, ADMH, ADHY examples",
          "ADSL, ADRS, ADLB, ADLBPCA",
          "ADSL, ADAE, ADAETTE, ADEX, ADLB, ADEG, ADVS, ADCM",
          "ADSL, ADTTE, ADRS_EFF, ADQS"
        ),
        check.names = FALSE
      ),
      `Open-source packages used` = data.frame(
        Packages = c("teal.modules.general", "teal.modules.clinical", "random.cdisc.data")
      )
    )
  )
}

#' Files shown by the File viewer: the parquet data folder when that source is
#' used, otherwise the installed package files (always present).
#' @noRd
teal_neue_file_viewer_paths <- function(source) {
  if (identical(source$source, "parquet")) {
    list("Parquet data folder" = source$parquet_dir)
  } else {
    list("teal_neue package files" = system.file(package = "teal.neue"))
  }
}

#' Exploratory Analysis (from inst/templates/app_exploratory.R)
#' @noRd
modules_exploratory <- function(file_viewer_paths) {
  pick_adsl_age <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(selected = "AGE", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adsl_bmrkr1 <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(selected = "BMRKR1", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adsl_armcd <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(selected = "ARMCD", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adsl_strata2 <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(is.factor, selected = "STRATA2", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adsl_armcd_multi <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(selected = "ARMCD", multiple = TRUE)
  )
  pick_adsl_numeric_bmrkr1 <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(is.numeric, selected = "BMRKR1", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adsl_factor <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(is.factor, selected = NULL, multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adsl_multi <- picks(
    datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"),
    variables(selected = c("AGE", "BMRKR1"), multiple = TRUE)
  )

  pick_adrs_response <- picks(
    datasets("ADRS", "ADRS"),
    variables(choices = c("AVALC", "AVAL"), selected = "AVALC", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adrs_response_fct <- picks(
    datasets("ADRS", "ADRS"),
    variables(choices = is.factor, selected = "AVALC", multiple = FALSE)
  )

  pick_adlb_aval <- picks(
    datasets("ADLB", "ADLB"),
    variables(choices = c("AVAL", "CHG", "PCHG", "ANRIND", "BASE"), selected = "AVAL", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adlb_outlier <- picks(
    datasets("ADLB", "ADLB"),
    variables(choices = c("AVAL", "CHG", "PCHG", "BASE"), selected = "AVAL", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  pick_adlb_categorical <- picks(
    datasets("ADLB", "ADLB"),
    variables(choices = c("PARAM", "PARAMCD"), selected = NULL, multiple = FALSE)
  )

  pick_adlbpca <- picks(
    datasets("ADLBPCA", "ADLBPCA"),
    variables(
      choices = is.numeric,
      selected = c("ALT - WEEK 5 DAY 36", "CRP - WEEK 5 DAY 36", "IGA - WEEK 5 DAY 36"),
      multiple = TRUE
    )
  )

  adrs_endpoint_filter <- teal_transform_filter(
    picks(
      datasets("ADRS", "ADRS"),
      variables(choices = "PARAMCD", selected = "PARAMCD", multiple = FALSE, fixed = TRUE),
      values(choices = c("BESRSPI", "INVET"), selected = "BESRSPI", multiple = FALSE)
    ),
    label = "Choose endpoint"
  )
  adlb_lab_filter <- teal_transform_filter(
    picks(
      datasets("ADLB", "ADLB"),
      variables(choices = "PARAMCD", selected = "PARAMCD", multiple = FALSE, fixed = TRUE),
      values(selected = "ALT", multiple = FALSE)
    ),
    label = "Select lab"
  )
  adlb_visit_filter <- teal_transform_filter(
    picks(
      datasets("ADLB", "ADLB"),
      variables(choices = "AVISIT", selected = "AVISIT", multiple = FALSE, fixed = TRUE),
      values(selected = "SCREENING", multiple = FALSE)
    ),
    label = "Select visit"
  )

  modules(
    label = "Exploratory Analysis",
    # NOTE: the template pointed at 3 remote demo files (checked over the network
    # at every start-up) and a non-existent ./packrat/desc/ folder.
    tm_file_viewer(
      label = "File viewer",
      input_path = file_viewer_paths
    ),
    tm_missing_data("Missing Data"),
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_g_distribution,
      "Distribution",
      dist_var = pick_adsl_numeric_bmrkr1,
      strata_var = pick_adsl_factor,
      group_var = pick_adsl_factor
    ),
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_outliers,
      "Outliers",
      outlier_var = pick_adlb_outlier,
      categorical_var = pick_adlb_categorical
    ),
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_g_association,
      label = "Association",
      ref = pick_adsl_age,
      vars = pick_adsl_armcd_multi
    ),
    # NOTE: the template fixed ggtheme = "gray"; the app-wide default is used instead
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_g_bivariate,
      label = "Bivariate Plots",
      x = pick_adsl_age,
      y = pick_adlb_aval,
      row_facet = pick_adsl_factor,
      col_facet = pick_adsl_factor,
      use_density = FALSE,
      plot_height = c(600L, 200L, 2000L),
      transformators = list(adlb_lab_filter, adlb_visit_filter)
    ),
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_a_regression,
      label = "Regression",
      response = pick_adsl_numeric_bmrkr1,
      regressor = pick_adrs_response,
      transformators = list(adrs_endpoint_filter)
    ),
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_g_response,
      label = "Response Plot",
      response = pick_adrs_response_fct,
      x = pick_adsl_strata2,
      row_facet = pick_adsl_factor,
      col_facet = pick_adsl_factor,
      coord_flip = FALSE,
      transformators = list(adrs_endpoint_filter)
    ),
    tm_g_scatterplotmatrix(
      label = "Scatterplot Matrix",
      variables = list(pick_adsl_multi)
    ),
    # NOTE: smaller, slightly transparent points (template: size = 3, alpha = 1)
    # so overlapping subjects stay visible
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_g_scatterplot,
      "Scatterplot",
      x = pick_adsl_age,
      y = pick_adsl_bmrkr1,
      row_facet = pick_adsl_factor,
      col_facet = pick_adsl_factor,
      color_by = pick_adsl_factor,
      size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8,
      plot_height = c(600L, 200L, 2000L)
    ),
    tm_t_crosstable(
      "Table Choices",
      x = pick_adsl_strata2,
      y = pick_adsl_armcd
    ),
    teal_neue_plot_module(
      tm_a_pca,
      "Principal Component Analysis",
      dat = pick_adlbpca,
      plot_height = c(600L, 200L, 2000L),
      plot_width = c(600L, 200L, 2000L)
    )
  )
}

#' Safety Analysis (from inst/templates/app_safety.R)
#' @noRd
modules_safety <- function(data) {
  ADSL <- data[["ADSL"]]
  ADAE <- data[["ADAE"]]

  # Safety uses the *actual* arm
  arm_vars_safety <- c("ACTARMCD", "ACTARM")
  date_vars_adsl <- names(ADSL)[vapply(ADSL, function(x) inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXct", "POSIXlt")), logical(1))]
  demog_vars_adsl <- names(ADSL)[!(names(ADSL) %in% c("USUBJID", "STUDYID", date_vars_adsl))]

  ae_anl_vars <- names(ADAE)[startsWith(names(ADAE), "TMPFL_")]
  # flag variables for AE baskets; set to NULL if not applicable to study
  aesi_vars <- names(ADAE)[startsWith(names(ADAE), "TMP_SMQ") | startsWith(names(ADAE), "TMP_CQ")]

  modules(
    label = "Safety Analysis",
    tm_t_summary(
      label = "Demographic Table (Safety)",
      dataname = "ADSL",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
      summarize_vars = variables(demog_vars_adsl, c("SEX", "AGE", "RACE"))
    ),
    modules(
      label = "Adverse Events",
      tm_t_events_summary(
        label = "AE Summary",
        dataname = "ADAE",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
        flag_var_anl = variables(ae_anl_vars, ae_anl_vars, multiple = TRUE),
        flag_var_aesi = variables(aesi_vars, aesi_vars, multiple = TRUE),
        add_total = TRUE
      ),
      tm_t_events(
        label = "AE by Term",
        dataname = "ADAE",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
        llt = variables(c("AETERM", "AEDECOD"), "AEDECOD"),
        hlt = variables(c("AEBODSYS", "AESOC"), "AEBODSYS"),
        add_total = TRUE,
        event_type = "adverse event"
      ),
      tm_t_events_by_grade(
        label = "AE Table by Grade",
        dataname = "ADAE",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
        llt = variables("AEDECOD", "AEDECOD"),
        hlt = variables(c("AEBODSYS", "AESOC"), "AEBODSYS"),
        grade = variables("AETOXGR", "AETOXGR"),
        add_total = TRUE
      ),
      tm_t_events_patyear(
        label = "AE Rates Adjusted for Patient-Years at Risk",
        dataname = "ADAETTE",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
        paramcd = picks(
          variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
          values(selected = "AETTE1", multiple = FALSE),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        ),
        events_var = variables("n_events", "n_events")
      ),
      tm_t_smq(
        label = "Adverse Events by SMQ Table",
        dataname = "ADAE",
        arm_var = variables(c(arm_vars_safety, "SEX"), "ACTARM"),
        add_total = FALSE,
        baskets = variables(
          function(x) grepl("^(SMQ|CQ).*NAM$", names(parent.frame()$X)[[parent.frame()$i]]),
          dplyr::everything(),
          multiple = TRUE
        ),
        scopes = variables(
          function(x) grepl("^SMQ.*SC$", names(parent.frame()$X)[[parent.frame()$i]]),
          dplyr::everything(),
          multiple = TRUE,
          fixed = TRUE
        ),
        llt = variables("AEDECOD", "AEDECOD")
      )
    ),
    modules(
      label = "Lab Tables",
      tm_t_summary_by(
        label = "Labs Summary",
        dataname = "ADLB",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
        by_vars = variables(c("PARAM", "AVISIT"), c("PARAM", "AVISIT"), multiple = TRUE, fixed = TRUE),
        summarize_vars = variables(c("AVAL", "CHG"), "AVAL"),
        paramcd = picks(
          variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
          values(selected = "ALT", multiple = TRUE),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        )
      ),
      tm_t_shift_by_grade(
        label = "Grade Laboratory Abnormality Table",
        dataname = "ADLB",
        arm_var = variables(c("ACTARMCD", "ACTARM"), "ACTARM"),
        paramcd = picks(
          variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
          values(selected = "ALT", multiple = TRUE),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        ),
        worst_flag_var = variables(c("WGRLOVFL", "WGRLOFL", "WGRHIVFL", "WGRHIFL"), "WGRLOVFL"),
        worst_flag_indicator = teal.picks::values("Y", "Y", fixed = TRUE, multiple = FALSE),
        anl_toxgrade_var = variables("ATOXGR", "ATOXGR"),
        base_toxgrade_var = variables("BTOXGR", "BTOXGR"),
        add_total = FALSE
      ),
      tm_t_abnormality_by_worst_grade(
        label = "Laboratory test results with highest grade post-baseline",
        dataname = "ADLB",
        arm_var = variables(c("ARM", "ARMCD"), "ARM"),
        paramcd = picks(
          variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
          values(selected = c("ALT", "CRP", "IGA")),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        ),
        add_total = FALSE
      )
    ),
    modules(
      label = "Exposure",
      tm_t_summary_by(
        label = "Exposure Summary",
        dataname = "ADEX",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
        by_vars = variables(c("PARCAT2", "PARAM"), c("PARCAT2", "PARAM"), fixed = TRUE),
        summarize_vars = variables("AVAL", "AVAL", fixed = TRUE),
        paramcd = picks(
          variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
          values(selected = "TDOSE", multiple = TRUE),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        ),
        denominator = values(c("n", "N", "omit"), "n")
      ),
      tm_t_exposure(
        label = "Duration of Exposure Table",
        dataname = "ADEX",
        paramcd = picks(
          variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
          values(selected = "TDURD", multiple = FALSE),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        ),
        col_by_var = variables(c(arm_vars_safety, "SEX"), "SEX"),
        row_by_var = variables(c("RACE", "REGION1", "STRATA1", "SEX"), "RACE"),
        parcat = picks(
          variables("PARCAT2", "PARCAT2"),
          values(selected = "Drug A"),
          check_dataset = FALSE
        ),
        add_total = FALSE
      )
    ),
    tm_t_abnormality(
      label = "Vital Signs Abnormality",
      dataname = "ADVS",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
      id_var = variables("USUBJID", "USUBJID", fixed = TRUE),
      by_vars = variables(c("PARAM", "AVISIT"), "PARAM", multiple = TRUE),
      grade = variables("ANRIND", "ANRIND", fixed = TRUE),
      abnormal = list(low = "LOW", high = "HIGH")
    ),
    tm_t_mult_events(
      label = "Concomitant Medication",
      dataname = "ADCM",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
      seq_var = variables("CMSEQ", "CMSEQ", fixed = TRUE),
      hlt = variables("ATC2", "ATC2", fixed = TRUE),
      llt = variables("CMDECOD", "CMDECOD", fixed = TRUE),
      add_total = TRUE,
      event_type = "treatment"
    ),
    tm_t_shift_by_arm(
      label = "ECG Shift Table by Arm",
      dataname = "ADEG",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
      paramcd = picks(
        variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
        values(selected = "HR", multiple = FALSE),
        check_dataset = FALSE
      ),
      visit_var = picks(
        variables("AVISIT", "AVISIT"),
        values(selected = "POST-BASELINE MINIMUM"),
        check_dataset = FALSE
      ),
      aval_var = variables("ANRIND", "ANRIND", fixed = TRUE),
      baseline_var = variables("BNRIND", "BNRIND", fixed = TRUE)
    ),
    tm_g_lineplot(
      label = "Line Plot",
      dataname = "ADLB",
      group_var = variables(arm_vars_safety, "ACTARM"),
      x = variables("AVISIT", "AVISIT", fixed = TRUE),
      y = variables(c("AVAL", "BASE", "CHG", "PCHG"), "AVAL"),
      y_unit = variables("AVALU", "AVALU", fixed = TRUE),
      paramcd = picks(
        variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD", fixed = TRUE),
        values(selected = "ALT", multiple = FALSE),
        check_dataset = FALSE
      ),
      plot_height = c(1000L, 200L, 4000L)
    )
  )
}

#' Efficacy Analysis (from inst/templates/app_efficacy.R)
#' @noRd
modules_efficacy <- function(data) {
  ADSL <- data[["ADSL"]]
  char_vars_asl <- data[[".teal_neue"]]$meta$adsl_char_vars

  # Efficacy uses the *planned* (randomised) arm
  arm_vars_efficacy <- c("ARMCD", "ARM")
  date_vars_adsl <- names(ADSL)[vapply(ADSL, function(x) inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXct", "POSIXlt")), logical(1))]
  demog_vars_adsl <- names(ADSL)[!(names(ADSL) %in% c("USUBJID", "STUDYID", date_vars_adsl))]

  strata_vars <- c("STRATA1", "STRATA2")
  facet_vars <- c("AGEGR1", "BMRKR2", "SEX", "COUNTRY")
  cov_vars <- c("AGE", "SEX", "BMRKR1", "BMRKR2", "REGION1")
  visit_vars <- c("AVISIT", "AVISITN")

  picks_paramcd_tte <- picks(
    check_dataset = FALSE,
    variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
    values(selected = "OS", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  picks_paramcd_rsp <- picks(
    check_dataset = FALSE,
    variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
    values(selected = "BESRSPI", multiple = FALSE)
  )
  picks_paramcd_qs <- picks(
    check_dataset = FALSE,
    variables("PARAMCD", "PARAMCD"),
    values(selected = "FKSI-FWB", multiple = FALSE)
  )

  fact_vars_asl <- names(Filter(isTRUE, sapply(ADSL, is.factor)))
  fact_vars_asl_orig <- fact_vars_asl[!fact_vars_asl %in% char_vars_asl]

  # reference & comparison arm selection when switching the arm variable
  # ARMCD is given in a delayed fashion using value choices and
  # ARM is given with the ref and comp levels supplied explicitly
  arm_ref_comp <- list(
    ARMCD = list(ref = "ARM A", comp = c("ARM B", "ARM C")),
    ARM = list(ref = "A: Drug X", comp = c("B: Placebo", "C: Combination"))
  )

  modules(
    label = "Efficacy Analysis",
    tm_t_summary(
      label = "Demographic Table (Efficacy)",
      dataname = "ADSL",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_efficacy, "ARM"),
      summarize_vars = variables(demog_vars_adsl, c("SEX", "AGE", "RACE"), multiple = TRUE)
    ),
    modules(
      label = "Forest Plots",
      tm_g_forest_tte(
        label = "Survival Forest Plot",
        dataname = "ADTTE",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_efficacy, "ARM"),
        strata_var = variables(strata_vars, "STRATA1", multiple = TRUE),
        subgroup_var = variables(facet_vars, "AGEGR1", multiple = TRUE),
        paramcd = picks_paramcd_tte,
        plot_height = c(800L, 200L, 4000L)
      ),
      tm_g_forest_rsp(
        label = "Response Forest Plot",
        dataname = "ADRS_EFF",
        arm_var = variables(arm_vars_efficacy, "ARM"),
        strata_var = variables(strata_vars, "STRATA1", multiple = TRUE),
        subgroup_var = variables(facet_vars, "AGEGR1", multiple = TRUE),
        paramcd = picks_paramcd_rsp,
        plot_height = c(800L, 200L, 4000L)
      )
    ),
    tm_g_km(
      label = "Kaplan Meier Plot",
      dataname = "ADTTE",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_efficacy, "ARM"),
      arm_ref_comp = arm_ref_comp,
      paramcd = picks_paramcd_tte,
      facet_var = variables(facet_vars, "AGEGR1"),
      strata_var = variables(strata_vars, "STRATA1"),
      plot_height = c(1800L, 200L, 4000L)
    ),
    tm_t_binary_outcome(
      label = "Response Table",
      dataname = "ADRS_EFF",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_efficacy, "ARM"),
      arm_ref_comp = arm_ref_comp,
      paramcd = picks_paramcd_rsp,
      strata_var = variables(strata_vars, "STRATA1"),
      rsp_table = TRUE
    ),
    tm_t_tte(
      label = "Time To Event Table",
      dataname = "ADTTE",
      arm_var = variables(arm_vars_efficacy, "ARM"),
      paramcd = picks_paramcd_tte,
      strata_var = variables(strata_vars, "STRATA1"),
      time_points = values(c(182, 365, 547), 182),
      event_desc_var = variables("EVNTDESC", "EVNTDESC")
    ),
    tm_t_crosstable(
      "Cross Table",
      x = picks(datasets("ADSL", "ADSL"), variables(fact_vars_asl_orig, 1L)),

#' Labels of all leaf modules inside a (nested) teal_modules object

# Data pipeline: ingestion -> pre-processing -> cache.

#' Load the analysis-ready teal_neue datasets
#'
#' The single entry point to the data. Returns the analysis-ready datasets,
#' using (in order) the first cache that is still valid:
#' 1. session memory (kept inside the package for the R session; makes
#'    repeated app launches instant),
#' 2. disk (`teal_neue_adam.rds` in `cache_dir`; survives R restarts),
#' 3. a fresh build: [ingest_adam()] then [preprocess_adam()], which is cached.
#'
#' Caches are invalidated automatically when the data-producing code changes
#' (package version or the ingestion/pre-processing functions) or when the data
#' source changes (source type, synthetic settings, 'random.cdisc.data'
#' version, or any parquet file's name, size or modification time).
#'
#' @inheritParams ingest_adam
#' @param use_cache Use (and maintain) the memory and disk caches?
#' @param refresh Ignore existing caches and rebuild from the source?
#' @param cache_global Also copy every dataset (`ADSL`, `ADAE`, ...) into
#'   `global_env` for easy console access?
#' @param cache_dir Folder of the disk cache.
#' @param global_env Environment receiving the dataset copies when
#'   `cache_global = TRUE`.
#' @param memory_env Environment holding the session memory cache.
#' @return A list with `datasets` (named list of data.frames), `meta`,
#'   `source` (the resolved source settings), `signature` and `created`.
#' @seealso [teal_neue_options], [teal_neue_clear_cache()]
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' neue <- load_teal_neue_data(cache_dir = tempdir())
#' names(neue$datasets)
#' # second call: served from the session memory cache
#' neue <- load_teal_neue_data(cache_dir = tempdir())
#' }
#' @export
load_teal_neue_data <- function(source = getOption("teal_neue.data_source", "bundled"),
                                synthetic = getOption("teal_neue.synthetic", list()),
                                parquet_dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache"),
                                use_cache = getOption("teal_neue.use_cache", TRUE),
                                refresh = getOption("teal_neue.refresh_cache", FALSE),
                                cache_global = getOption("teal_neue.cache_global", FALSE),
                                cache_dir = teal_neue_cache_dir_default(),
                                global_env = globalenv(),
                                memory_env = the) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  config <- teal_neue_source_config(source, synthetic, parquet_dir)
  signature <- teal_neue_data_signature(config)
  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "teal_neue_adam.rds")
  result <- NULL

  if (isTRUE(use_cache) && !isTRUE(refresh)) {
    mem <- get0("data_cache", envir = memory_env, inherits = FALSE)
    if (is.list(mem) && identical(mem$signature, signature)) {
      result <- mem
      from <- "session memory cache"
    } else if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      disk <- tryCatch(readRDS(cache_file), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.list(disk) && identical(disk$signature, signature)) {
        result <- disk
        from <- paste("disk cache", sQuote(cache_file, FALSE))
      }
    }
  }

  if (is.null(result)) {
    raw <- ingest_adam(config$source, config$synthetic, config$parquet_dir)
    result <- preprocess_adam(raw)
    result$source <- config
    result$signature <- signature
    result$created <- Sys.time()
    from <- sprintf("%s source (fresh ingestion + pre-processing)", config$source)
    if (isTRUE(use_cache)) {
      tryCatch(
        {
          dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
          saveRDS(result, cache_file)
        },
        error = function(e) warning("[teal_neue] Could not write disk cache: ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
      )
    }
  }

  if (isTRUE(use_cache)) {
    assign("data_cache", result, envir = memory_env)
  }

  if (isTRUE(cache_global)) {
    list2env(result$datasets, envir = global_env)
    message("[teal_neue] Datasets available in the Global Environment: ", toString(names(result$datasets)))
  }

  message(sprintf(
    "[teal_neue] %d datasets ready from %s in %.1fs",
    length(result$datasets), from, as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  ))
  result
}

#' Remove the teal_neue data caches
#'
#' Clears the session memory caches (data and the app built from it) and
#' deletes the disk cache file; optionally also removes the dataset copies
#' made with `cache_global = TRUE`.
#'
#' @inheritParams load_teal_neue_data
#' @param remove_global_datasets Also remove `ADSL`, `ADAE`, ... from
#'   `global_env`?
#' @return Invisibly `TRUE`.
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' teal_neue_clear_cache(cache_dir = tempdir())
#' }
#' @export
teal_neue_clear_cache <- function(cache_dir = teal_neue_cache_dir_default(),
                                  remove_global_datasets = FALSE,
                                  global_env = globalenv(),
                                  memory_env = the) {
  mem <- get0("data_cache", envir = memory_env, inherits = FALSE)
  if (isTRUE(remove_global_datasets) && is.list(mem)) {
    suppressWarnings(rm(list = names(mem$datasets), envir = global_env))
  }
  if (!is.null(mem)) rm("data_cache", envir = memory_env)
  if (exists("app_cache", envir = memory_env, inherits = FALSE)) rm("app_cache", envir = memory_env)
  unlink(file.path(cache_dir, "teal_neue_adam.rds"))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

#' Cache signature: changes whenever the data-producing code or the source changes
#' @noRd
teal_neue_data_signature <- function(config = teal_neue_source_config(),
                                     code = teal_neue_code_fingerprint(),
                                     cache_version = 3L) {
  paste(c(cache_version, code, teal_neue_source_fingerprint(config)), collapse = "|")
}

#' Hash of the package version and of every function that produces data
#' @noRd
teal_neue_code_fingerprint <- function() {
  ns <- environment(teal_neue_code_fingerprint)
  pattern <- "^(ingest_|preprocess_|derive_|decode_ae_|ae_|adsl_character_vars$|recode_column$|synthetic_settings$)"
  fns <- sort(grep(pattern, ls(ns, all.names = TRUE), value = TRUE))
  rlang::hash(list(
    version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("teal.neue")),
    code = lapply(mget(fns, envir = ns), deparse)
  ))
}

# Data ingestion: raw ADaM datasets from the configured source, checked
# against the data contract. No study-specific manipulation happens here
# (see preprocess.R).

#' @noRd
teal_neue_data_sources <- function() c("bundled", "synthetic", "parquet")

#' Ingest raw ADaM datasets
#'
#' Reads the raw ADaM datasets from the configured source and checks them
#' against the data contract ([adam_contract()]). No study-specific
#' manipulation happens here (see [preprocess_adam()]).
#'
#' Data sources:
#' * `"bundled"`: the pre-generated datasets shipped with 'random.cdisc.data'
#'   (`cadsl`, `cadae`, ...). Fast; always the same data.
#' * `"synthetic"`: freshly generated data (`random.cdisc.data::radsl()`,
#'   `radae()`, ...) using `synthetic = list(N, seed, args)`. A missing or `NA`
#'   seed draws a random seed once per session (printed in the console and
#'   stored in option `teal_neue.synthetic`).
#' * `"parquet"`: every ADaM parquet file in `parquet_dir`, named
#'   `adsl.parquet`, `adae.parquet`, ... or `adsl_adam.parquet`, ...
#'   (case-insensitive). Other files are ignored. Needs the 'arrow' package.
#'
#' @param source Data source: `"bundled"`, `"synthetic"` or `"parquet"`.
#' @param synthetic Settings for the synthetic source: a list with `N`
#'   (subjects), `seed` and `args` (extra `rad*()` arguments per dataset, e.g.
#'   `list(ADAE = list(max_n_aes = 5))`). Missing entries use the defaults
#'   `N = 400`, `seed = 2025`.
#' @param parquet_dir Folder read by the parquet source.
#' @return Named list of data.frames (raw datasets). Extra datasets found in a
#'   parquet folder are kept but reported.
#' @seealso [teal_neue_options], [export_adam_parquet()], [validate_adam()]
#' @examples
#' raw <- ingest_adam("bundled")
#' names(raw)
#' \donttest{
#' small <- ingest_adam("synthetic", synthetic = list(N = 30, seed = 1))
#' nrow(small$ADSL)
#' }
#' @export
ingest_adam <- function(source = getOption("teal_neue.data_source", "bundled"),
                        synthetic = getOption("teal_neue.synthetic", list()),
                        parquet_dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache")) {
  config <- teal_neue_source_config(source, synthetic, parquet_dir)
  raw <- switch(config$source,
    bundled = ingest_bundled(),
    synthetic = ingest_synthetic(config$synthetic),
    parquet = ingest_parquet(config$parquet_dir)
  )
  extra <- setdiff(names(raw), names(adam_contract()))
  if (length(extra)) {
    message("[teal_neue] Datasets read but not used by the app: ", toString(extra))
  }
  validate_adam(raw)
  check_app_defaults(raw)
  raw
}

#' Resolve and normalise the data-source settings
#' @noRd
teal_neue_source_config <- function(source = getOption("teal_neue.data_source", "bundled"),
                                    synthetic = getOption("teal_neue.synthetic", list()),
                                    parquet_dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache")) {
  source <- match.arg(source, teal_neue_data_sources())
  list(
    source = source,
    synthetic = if (source == "synthetic") synthetic_settings(synthetic),
    parquet_dir = if (source == "parquet") normalizePath(parquet_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  )
}

#' Fingerprint of the data source, used to invalidate the cache
#' @noRd
teal_neue_source_fingerprint <- function(config) {
  rcd_version <- function() {
    tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("random.cdisc.data")), error = function(e) NA_character_)
  }
  switch(config$source,
    bundled = paste("bundled", rcd_version()),
    synthetic = paste("synthetic", rcd_version(), deparse1(config$synthetic)),
    parquet = {
      files <- adam_parquet_files(config$parquet_dir)
      info <- file.info(files)
      paste("parquet", config$parquet_dir, paste(basename(files), info$size, format(as.numeric(info$mtime), nsmall = 3), collapse = ";"))
    }
  )
}

# ---- Source: bundled ----------------------------------------------------------

#' @noRd
ingest_bundled <- function() {
  list(
    ADSL    = random.cdisc.data::cadsl,
    ADAE    = random.cdisc.data::cadae,
    ADAETTE = random.cdisc.data::cadaette,
    ADCM    = random.cdisc.data::cadcm,
    ADEG    = random.cdisc.data::cadeg,
    ADEX    = random.cdisc.data::cadex,
    ADLB    = random.cdisc.data::cadlb,
    ADQS    = random.cdisc.data::cadqs,
    ADRS    = random.cdisc.data::cadrs,
    ADTTE   = random.cdisc.data::cadtte,
    ADVS    = random.cdisc.data::cadvs
  )
}

# ---- Source: freshly generated synthetic data --------------------------------

#' Complete and check the synthetic-data settings
#'
#' A missing/NA seed means "random": a seed is drawn once and written back to
#' option `teal_neue.synthetic`, so every later call in the session (including the
#' app's reproducible R code) generates the very same data.
#' @noRd
synthetic_settings <- function(settings = list()) {
  settings <- as.list(settings)
  random_seed <- "seed" %in% names(settings) &&
    (is.null(settings[["seed"]]) || (length(settings[["seed"]]) == 1 && is.na(settings[["seed"]])))
  settings <- settings[!vapply(settings, is.null, logical(1))]
  s <- utils::modifyList(list(N = 400L, seed = 2025L, args = list()), settings)

  if (random_seed) {
    s$seed <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 1L)
    options(teal_neue.synthetic = utils::modifyList(settings, list(seed = s$seed)))
    message("[teal_neue] Random synthetic-data seed: ", s$seed,
            " (set options(teal_neue.synthetic = list(seed = ", s$seed, ")) to reproduce)")
  }

  if (!is.numeric(s$N) || length(s$N) != 1 || is.na(s$N) || s$N < 1 || s$N != round(s$N)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] teal_neue.synthetic$N must be a single positive whole number.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.numeric(s$seed) || length(s$seed) != 1) {
    stop("[teal_neue] teal_neue.synthetic$seed must be a single number (or NA for a random seed).", call. = FALSE)
  }
  unknown <- setdiff(names(s$args), names(adam_contract()))
  if (!is.list(s$args) || length(unknown)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] teal_neue.synthetic$args must be a list named by dataset (",
         toString(names(adam_contract())), "). Unknown: ", toString(unknown), call. = FALSE)
  }
  s$N <- as.integer(s$N)
  s$seed <- as.integer(s$seed)
  s
}

#' @noRd
ingest_synthetic <- function(settings = synthetic_settings()) {
  generate <- function(dataset, fun, base_args) {
    f <- getExportedValue("random.cdisc.data", fun)
    do.call(f, utils::modifyList(base_args, as.list(settings$args[[dataset]])))
  }
  adsl <- generate("ADSL", "radsl", list(N = settings$N, seed = settings$seed))
  child <- function(dataset, fun) generate(dataset, fun, list(adsl = adsl, seed = settings$seed))
  list(
    ADSL    = adsl,
    ADAE    = child("ADAE", "radae"),
    ADAETTE = child("ADAETTE", "radaette"),
    ADCM    = child("ADCM", "radcm"),
    ADEG    = child("ADEG", "radeg"),
    ADEX    = child("ADEX", "radex"),
    ADLB    = child("ADLB", "radlb"),
    ADQS    = child("ADQS", "radqs"),
    ADRS    = child("ADRS", "radrs"),
    ADTTE   = child("ADTTE", "radtte"),
    ADVS    = child("ADVS", "radvs")
  )
}

# ---- Source: parquet folder --------------------------------------------------

#' Dataset name from a parquet file name: adsl.parquet / adsl_adam.parquet -> "ADSL"
#' @noRd
adam_name_from_file <- function(path) {
  toupper(sub("_?adam\\.parquet$|\\.parquet$", "", basename(path), ignore.case = TRUE))
}

#' ADaM parquet files in a folder, named by dataset
#' @noRd
adam_parquet_files <- function(dir) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] Parquet folder not found: ", dir, call. = FALSE)
  }
  files <- sort(list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.parquet$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
  names(files) <- adam_name_from_file(files)
  files <- files[grepl("^AD[A-Z0-9_]+$", names(files))]
  if (!length(files)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] No ADaM parquet files (ad*.parquet or ad*_adam.parquet) in: ", dir, call. = FALSE)
  }
  dup <- unique(names(files)[duplicated(names(files))])
  if (length(dup)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] More than one parquet file for: ", toString(dup), " in ", dir, call. = FALSE)
  }
  files
}

#' @noRd
require_arrow <- function(available = requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!isTRUE(available)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] The parquet data source needs the 'arrow' package. Install it with:\n",
         "  renv::install(\"arrow\"); renv::snapshot()", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

#' @noRd
ingest_parquet <- function(dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache")) {
  require_arrow()
  files <- adam_parquet_files(dir)
  lapply(files, arrow::read_parquet)
}

#' Write ADaM datasets as parquet files
#'
#' Writes each dataset as `<name>.parquet` (e.g. `adsl.parquet`), the layout
#' read by the `"parquet"` source of [ingest_adam()]. Typical uses: freeze a
#' synthetic draw, or hand data over to other tools. Needs the 'arrow' package.
#'
#' @param datasets Named list of data.frames, e.g. from [ingest_adam()].
#' @param dir Output folder (created if needed).
#' @param overwrite Overwrite existing files?
#' @return Invisibly, the written file paths, named by dataset.
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' if (requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
#'   dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "adam")
#'   export_adam_parquet(ingest_adam("bundled"), dir, overwrite = TRUE)
#'   list.files(dir)
#' }
#' }
#' @export
export_adam_parquet <- function(datasets, dir, overwrite = FALSE) {
  require_arrow()
  dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  paths <- file.path(dir, paste0(tolower(names(datasets)), ".parquet"))
  if (!overwrite && any(file.exists(paths))) {
    stop("[teal_neue] Files already exist (use overwrite = TRUE): ", toString(basename(paths[file.exists(paths)])), call. = FALSE)
  }
  for (i in seq_along(datasets)) arrow::write_parquet(datasets[[i]], paths[[i]])
  invisible(stats::setNames(paths, names(datasets)))
}

# ---- Data contract -----------------------------------------------------------

#' The app's data contract
#'
#' `adam_contract()` lists the datasets and columns the app needs from *any*
#' data source (raw, before pre-processing). `validate_adam()` checks raw data
#' against it and stops with a list of *every* problem: missing datasets or
#' columns, empty datasets, non-data.frames, or an ADSL with more than one row
#' per subject. Subjects missing from ADSL only give a warning.
#'
#' `adam_app_defaults()` lists the values the app's modules select by default
#' (e.g. `PARAMCD == "OS"`); `check_app_defaults()` warns about the ones the
#' data lacks, which then need adjusting in the module configuration.
#'
#' @param raw Named list of raw datasets.
#' @param contract Named list of required columns per dataset.
#' @param defaults List of `list(dataset, column, values)` entries.
#' @return `adam_contract()`: named list of column names. `adam_app_defaults()`:
#'   list of `list(dataset, column, values)`. `validate_adam()`: invisibly
#'   `TRUE`. `check_app_defaults()`: invisibly, the missing values (character).
#' @examples
#' names(adam_contract())
#' adam_contract()$ADTTE
#' raw <- ingest_adam("bundled")
#' validate_adam(raw)
#' check_app_defaults(raw)
#' @export
adam_contract <- function() {
  list(
    ADSL = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "AGE", "SEX", "RACE", "COUNTRY", "REGION1", "ARM", "ARMCD",
             "ACTARM", "ACTARMCD", "SAFFL", "ITTFL", "STRATA1", "STRATA2", "BMRKR1", "BMRKR2"),
    ADAE = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "AETERM", "AEDECOD", "AEBODSYS", "AESOC", "AETOXGR", "AESER",
             "AEREL", "SMQ01NAM", "SMQ01SC", "SMQ02NAM", "SMQ02SC", "CQ01NAM"),
    ADAETTE = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "ARM", "ARMCD", "PARAMCD", "AVAL", "CNSR"),
    ADCM = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "CMSEQ", "ATC2", "CMDECOD"),
    ADEG = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT", "AVAL", "ANRIND", "BNRIND"),
    ADEX = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "PARAM", "AVAL", "PARCAT1", "PARCAT2"),
    ADLB = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "SEX", "ARMCD", "PARAMCD", "PARAM", "AVISIT", "AVAL", "BASE",
             "CHG", "PCHG", "ANRIND", "AVALU", "ATOXGR", "BTOXGR", "WGRLOVFL", "WGRLOFL",
             "WGRHIVFL", "WGRHIFL"),
    ADQS = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT", "AVISITN", "AVAL", "BASE", "CHG", "PCHG",
             "ABLFL", "ABLFL2"),
    ADRS = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT", "AVAL", "AVALC"),
    ADTTE = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVAL", "CNSR", "EVNTDESC"),
    ADVS = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "PARAM", "AVISIT", "ANRIND", "BNRIND")
  )
}

#' @rdname adam_contract
#' @export
validate_adam <- function(raw, contract = adam_contract()) {
  problems <- character(0)
  missing_ds <- setdiff(names(contract), names(raw))
  if (length(missing_ds)) problems <- c(problems, paste("missing datasets:", toString(missing_ds)))

  for (ds in intersect(names(contract), names(raw))) {
    x <- raw[[ds]]
    if (!is.data.frame(x)) {
      problems <- c(problems, sprintf("%s is not a data.frame", ds))
      next
    }
    if (nrow(x) == 0) problems <- c(problems, sprintf("%s has no rows", ds))
    missing_cols <- setdiff(contract[[ds]], names(x))
    if (length(missing_cols)) problems <- c(problems, sprintf("%s is missing columns: %s", ds, toString(missing_cols)))
  }

  adsl <- raw[["ADSL"]]
  if (is.data.frame(adsl) && "USUBJID" %in% names(adsl) && anyDuplicated(adsl$USUBJID)) {
    problems <- c(problems, "ADSL has duplicated USUBJID values (must be one row per subject)")
  }
  if (length(problems)) {
    stop("[teal_neue] The ADaM data does not meet the app's data contract:\n  - ",
         paste(problems, collapse = "\n  - "), call. = FALSE)
  }

  # Subjects in analysis datasets without an ADSL record are dropped by the
  # ADSL-based filters, so flag them (warning, not error: it can be legitimate)
  orphans <- vapply(setdiff(names(contract), "ADSL"), function(ds) {
    length(setdiff(unique(as.character(raw[[ds]]$USUBJID)), as.character(adsl$USUBJID)))
  }, integer(1))
  if (any(orphans > 0)) {
    warning("[teal_neue] Subjects without an ADSL record: ",
            toString(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(orphans)[orphans > 0], orphans[orphans > 0])), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

#' @rdname adam_contract
#' @export
adam_app_defaults <- function() {
  list(
    list("ADSL", "ARMCD", c("ARM A", "ARM B", "ARM C")),
    list("ADSL", "ARM", c("A: Drug X", "B: Placebo", "C: Combination")),
    list("ADAETTE", "PARAMCD", c("AETTE1", "AEREPTTE")),
    list("ADEG", "PARAMCD", "HR"),
    list("ADEG", "AVISIT", "POST-BASELINE MINIMUM"),
    list("ADEX", "PARAMCD", "TDOSE"),
    list("ADEX", "PARCAT1", "OVERALL"),
    list("ADEX", "PARCAT2", "Drug A"),
    list("ADLB", "PARAMCD", c("ALT", "CRP", "IGA")),
    list("ADLB", "AVISIT", c("SCREENING", "WEEK 5 DAY 36")),
    list("ADQS", "PARAMCD", "FKSI-FWB"),
    list("ADQS", "AVISIT", "WEEK 1 DAY 8"),
    list("ADRS", "PARAMCD", c("BESRSPI", "INVET")),
    list("ADTTE", "PARAMCD", "OS")
  )
}

#' @rdname adam_contract
#' @export
check_app_defaults <- function(raw, defaults = adam_app_defaults()) {
  missing <- unlist(lapply(defaults, function(d) {
    x <- raw[[d[[1]]]][[d[[2]]]]
    absent <- setdiff(d[[3]], unique(as.character(x)))
    if (length(absent)) sprintf("%s$%s: %s", d[[1]], d[[2]], toString(absent))
  }))
  if (length(missing)) {
    warning("[teal_neue] Values used as default selections in the app are not in the data ",
            "(update app.R): ", paste(missing, collapse = "; "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(missing)
}
