content:
# Plot defaults: cleaner typography for every ggplot2-based module, and a
# modern default theme for the exploratory plot modules.
#
# Both go through teal's own, documented mechanisms (the `teal.ggplot2_args`
# option and the modules' `ggtheme` arguments), so they appear in each
# module's "Show R code" and the reproduced plots match the app exactly.
# Fonts are deliberately *not* set in the plots: a font family in the code
# would break "Show R code" and PDF downloads on machines without that font.

#' Plot defaults for the teal modules
#'
#' `teal_neue_ggplot2_args()` returns the value the app gives to option
#' `teal.ggplot2_args` (unless you set that option yourself): the
#' teal.gallery caption plus a cleaner, editorial look that works on top of
#' any ggplot2 theme the user picks in a module: large left-aligned bold
#' titles, a graded ink scale (titles, axis titles, labels, captions),
#' facet labels as bold left-aligned headings instead of grey strips, no
#' tick marks or minor grid lines, plain legend keys and more breathing room.
#' Data colours (the NEST palette from 'nestcolor') are left unchanged.
#'
#' `teal_neue_plot_theme_args()` returns just the theme part, as quoted
#' `ggplot2` calls so that "Show R code" prints readable code.
#'
#' @param style Use the teal_neue refinements? `FALSE` returns the plain
#'   teal.gallery default (caption only). Defaults to option `teal_neue.style`.
#' @return `teal_neue_ggplot2_args()`: a `teal.widgets::ggplot2_args()`
#'   object. `teal_neue_plot_theme_args()`: a named list of arguments for
#'   [ggplot2::theme()].
#' @seealso [teal_neue_options]
#' @examples
#' theme_args <- teal_neue_plot_theme_args()
#' names(theme_args)
#' if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
#'   library(ggplot2)
#'   ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
#'     geom_point() +
#'     labs(title = "Fuel economy", caption = "NEST PROJECT") +
#'     theme_bw() +
#'     do.call(theme, lapply(theme_args, eval))
#' }
#' @export
teal_neue_ggplot2_args <- function(style = teal_neue_style_enabled()) {
  labs <- list(caption = "NEST PROJECT")
  if (!isTRUE(style)) {
    return(teal.widgets::ggplot2_args(labs = labs))
  }
  teal.widgets::ggplot2_args(labs = labs, theme = teal_neue_plot_theme_args())
}

#' @rdname teal_neue_ggplot2_args
#' @export
teal_neue_plot_theme_args <- function() {
  ink <- "#0F1720"   # titles, facet labels
  ink2 <- "#3A4651"  # axis and legend titles, legend labels
  ink3 <- "#66737F"  # axis labels, subtitles
  ink4 <- "#95A1AB"  # captions
  list(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.title = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = ggplot2::rel(1.25), colour = .(ink), margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 4))),
    plot.subtitle = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(colour = .(ink3), margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 10))),
    plot.caption = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(colour = .(ink4), size = ggplot2::rel(0.72), hjust = 1, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10))),
    plot.margin = quote(ggplot2::margin(12, 16, 10, 12)),
    axis.title = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(colour = .(ink2), size = ggplot2::rel(0.92))),
    axis.text = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(colour = .(ink3))),
    axis.ticks = quote(ggplot2::element_blank()),
    panel.grid.minor = quote(ggplot2::element_blank()),
    panel.spacing = quote(ggplot2::unit(14, "pt")),
    strip.background = quote(ggplot2::element_blank()),
    strip.text = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", colour = .(ink), hjust = 0, size = ggplot2::rel(0.95), margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 0, 6, 0))),
    legend.title = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", colour = .(ink2), size = ggplot2::rel(0.9))),
    legend.text = bquote(ggplot2::element_text(colour = .(ink2))),
    legend.key = quote(ggplot2::element_blank())
  )
}

#' Set the plot-related options the app relies on
#'
#' Only options the user has not set are changed. `teal.ggplot2_args` is also
#' updated when it still holds the value set by an earlier app build in this
#' session (e.g. after changing option `teal_neue.style`).
#' @noRd
teal_neue_set_app_options <- function(memory_env = the) {
  if (is.null(getOption("shiny.useragg"))) options(shiny.useragg = FALSE)

  current <- getOption("teal.ggplot2_args")
  if (is.null(current) || identical(current, memory_env$ggplot2_args)) {
    memory_env$ggplot2_args <- teal_neue_ggplot2_args()
    options(teal.ggplot2_args = memory_env$ggplot2_args)
  }
  invisible()
}

#' Call a teal.modules.general plot module with the app's default ggplot2 theme
#'
#' Adds the module's theme argument(s) (`ggtheme`, or `distribution_theme` and
#' `association_theme` for the association module) set to `ggtheme`, but only
#' the ones the installed module version accepts and whose allowed values
#' include `ggtheme`. If the module warns that a theme argument is deprecated,
#' it is built again without it. A change in a module's arguments can therefore
#' never break the app (or flood it with warnings); the module's own default is
#' used instead. Arguments given explicitly in `...` always win.
#' @param module A module function, e.g. `tm_g_scatterplot`.
#' @param ... Arguments for `module`.
#' @param ggtheme Theme name (option `teal_neue.ggtheme`); `NULL` adds nothing.
#' @noRd
teal_neue_plot_module <- function(module, ..., ggtheme = teal_neue_ggtheme()) {
  args <- list(...)
  theme_args <- teal_neue_theme_args(module, ggtheme, exclude = names(args))
  if (!length(theme_args)) {
    return(do.call(module, args))
  }
  deprecated <- FALSE
  result <- withCallingHandlers(
    do.call(module, c(args, theme_args)),
    warning = function(w) {
      about_theme <- any(vapply(names(theme_args), grepl, logical(1), x = conditionMessage(w), fixed = TRUE))
      if (about_theme && (inherits(w, "lifecycle_warning_deprecated") || grepl("deprecat", conditionMessage(w), ignore.case = TRUE))) {
        deprecated <<- TRUE
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    }
  )
  if (deprecated) do.call(module, args) else result
}

#' @noRd
teal_neue_theme_args <- function(module, ggtheme = teal_neue_ggtheme(), exclude = character(0)) {
  if (is.null(ggtheme)) {
    return(list())
  }
  fmls <- formals(module)
  candidates <- setdiff(intersect(c("ggtheme", "distribution_theme", "association_theme"), names(fmls)), exclude)
  supported <- vapply(candidates, function(arg) {
    choices <- tryCatch(eval(fmls[[arg]], envir = environment(module)), error = function(e) NULL)
    is.character(choices) && ggtheme %in% choices
  }, logical(1))
  stats::setNames(rep(list(ggtheme), sum(supported)), candidates[supported])
}

name: R/preprocess.R
content:
# Pre-processing: turns the raw ADaM datasets from ingest_adam() into the
# analysis-ready datasets used by the app. The logic is taken unchanged from
# the three teal.gallery templates (inst/templates/); only the packaging
# changed (one function per dataset, fully namespaced calls).

#' Pre-process raw ADaM datasets
#'
#' Turns the raw datasets from [ingest_adam()] into the analysis-ready
#' datasets used by the app, following the teal.gallery templates:
#' * `ADSL`: adds `AGEGR1` (age group) and converts character columns to factors.
#' * `ADRS_EFF`: efficacy subset of `ADRS` (best overall response + follow-up).
#' * `ADLBPCA`: wide lab data (one column per lab x visit) for the PCA module.
#' * `ADQS`: the three post-baseline analysis visits.
#' * `ADAE`: readable adverse event names ([decode_ae_terms()]) and analysis flags.
#' * `ADAETTE`, `ADEX`, `ADVS`, `ADCM`: safety template derivations.
#'
#' @param raw Named list of raw datasets, e.g. from [ingest_adam()].
#' @return A list with `datasets` (named list of the 13 analysis-ready
#'   data.frames) and `meta` (extra information for the app configuration).
#' @examples
#' out <- preprocess_adam(ingest_adam("bundled"))
#' names(out$datasets)
#' levels(out$datasets$ADSL$AGEGR1)
#' @export
preprocess_adam <- function(raw) {
  list(
    datasets = list(
      # shared
      ADSL     = preprocess_adsl(raw$ADSL),
      ADLB     = raw$ADLB,
      # exploratory
      ADRS     = raw$ADRS,
      ADLBPCA  = derive_adlbpca(raw$ADLB),
      # efficacy
      ADRS_EFF = derive_adrs_efficacy(raw$ADRS),
      ADTTE    = raw$ADTTE,
      ADQS     = preprocess_adqs(raw$ADQS),
      # safety
      ADAE     = preprocess_adae(raw$ADAE),
      ADAETTE  = preprocess_adaette(raw$ADAETTE),
      ADEX     = preprocess_adex(raw$ADEX),
      ADEG     = raw$ADEG,
      ADVS     = preprocess_advs(raw$ADVS),
      ADCM     = preprocess_adcm(raw$ADCM)
    ),
    meta = list(
      # ADSL columns that were character before being converted to factors
      # (used by the efficacy "Cross Table" to offer only the original factors)
      adsl_char_vars = adsl_character_vars(raw$ADSL)
    )
  )
}

# ---- ADSL (shared; efficacy template pre-processing) -------------------------

#' @noRd
adsl_character_vars <- function(adsl) {
  names(Filter(isTRUE, sapply(adsl, is.character)))
}

#' @noRd
preprocess_adsl <- function(adsl) {
  labels <- teal.data::col_labels(adsl, fill = FALSE)
  char_vars <- adsl_character_vars(adsl)
  labels <- c(labels, AGEGR1 = "Age Group")

  adsl <- adsl |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      AGEGR1 = factor(dplyr::case_when(
        AGE < 45 ~ "<45",
        AGE >= 45 ~ ">=45"
      ))
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(char_vars), factor))

  teal.data::col_labels(adsl) <- labels
  adsl
}

# ---- Exploratory -------------------------------------------------------------

# Wide lab data (one column per PARAMCD x AVISIT) for the PCA module
#' @noRd
derive_adlbpca <- function(adlb) {
  adlb |>
    dplyr::select(USUBJID, STUDYID, SEX, ARMCD, AVAL, AVISIT, PARAMCD) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      values_from = "AVAL",
      names_from = c("PARAMCD", "AVISIT"),
      names_sep = " - "
    )
}

# ---- Efficacy ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Efficacy response subset: best overall response + follow-up records
#' @noRd
derive_adrs_efficacy <- function(adrs) {
  labels <- teal.data::col_labels(adrs, fill = FALSE)
  adrs <- dplyr::filter(adrs, PARAMCD == "BESRSPI" | AVISIT == "FOLLOW UP")
  teal.data::col_labels(adrs) <- labels
  adrs
}

#' @noRd
preprocess_adqs <- function(adqs) {
  labels <- teal.data::col_labels(adqs, fill = FALSE)
  adqs <- adqs |>
    dplyr::filter(ABLFL != "Y" & ABLFL2 != "Y") |>
    dplyr::filter(AVISIT %in% c("WEEK 1 DAY 8", "WEEK 2 DAY 15", "WEEK 3 DAY 22")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      AVISIT = as.factor(AVISIT),
      AVISITN = rank(AVISITN) |>
        as.factor() |>
        as.numeric() |>
        as.factor()
    )
  teal.data::col_labels(adqs) <- labels
  adqs
}

# ---- Safety ------------------------------------------------------------------

#' @noRd
preprocess_adaette <- function(adaette) {
  adaette <- adaette |>
    dplyr::mutate(is_event = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("TOT", .data$PARAMCD, fixed = TRUE) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ CNSR == 0
    )) |>
    dplyr::mutate(n_events = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("TOT", .data$PARAMCD, fixed = TRUE) ~ as.integer(.data$AVAL),
      TRUE ~ as.integer(is_event)
    )) |>
    teal.data::col_relabel(is_event = "Is an Event") |>
    teal.data::col_relabel(n_events = "Number of Events")

  adaette_ae <- dplyr::filter(adaette, grepl("TOT", .data$PARAMCD, fixed = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::select(-"AVAL")
  adaette_oth <- dplyr::filter(adaette, !(grepl("TOT", .data$PARAMCD, fixed = TRUE)))

  adaette_tte <- adaette |>
    dplyr::filter(PARAMCD == "AEREPTTE") |>
    dplyr::select(USUBJID, ARM, ARMCD, AVAL)

  adaette_ae <- dplyr::full_join(adaette_ae, adaette_tte, by = c("USUBJID", "ARM", "ARMCD"))
  rbind(adaette_ae, adaette_oth)
}

#' @noRd
preprocess_adex <- function(adex) {
  labels <- teal.data::col_labels(adex, fill = FALSE)
  # Simulate the TDURD parameter, which is not in the ADEX data from
  # `random.cdisc.data` (fixed seed => identical values on every run)
  set.seed(1, kind = "Mersenne-Twister")
  adex <- adex |>
    dplyr::distinct(USUBJID, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      PARAMCD = "TDURD",
      PARAM = "Overall duration (days)",
      AVAL = sample(
        x = seq(1, 200),
        size = dplyr::n(),
        replace = TRUE
      ),
      AVALU = "Days",
      PARCAT1 = "OVERALL"
    ) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows(adex)
  adex <- adex |>
    dplyr::filter(PARCAT1 == "OVERALL" & PARAMCD %in% c("TDOSE", "TNDOSE", "TDURD"))
  teal.data::col_labels(adex) <- labels
  adex
}

# For real data, ADVS needs some preprocessing like grouping different ANRIND
# and BNRIND into abnormal
#' @noRd
preprocess_advs <- function(advs) {
  advs |>
    dplyr::mutate(ONTRTFL = ifelse(AVISIT %in% c("SCREENING", "BASELINE"), "", "Y")) |>
    teal.data::col_relabel(ONTRTFL = "On Treatment Record Flag") |>
    dplyr::mutate(ANRIND = as.character(ANRIND), BNRIND = as.character(BNRIND)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      ANRIND = dplyr::case_when(
        ANRIND == "HIGH HIGH" ~ "HIGH",
        ANRIND == "LOW LOW" ~ "LOW",
        TRUE ~ ANRIND
      ),
      BNRIND = dplyr::case_when(
        BNRIND == "HIGH HIGH" ~ "HIGH",
        BNRIND == "LOW LOW" ~ "LOW",
        TRUE ~ BNRIND
      )
    )
}

#' @noRd
preprocess_adcm <- function(adcm) {
  dplyr::mutate(adcm, CMSEQ = as.integer(CMSEQ))
}

# Study-specific analysis subgroups and baskets from ADAE
#' @noRd
preprocess_adae <- function(adae) {
  # Readable AE names first, so the AESI basket labels below use them too
  adae <- decode_ae_terms(adae)
  adae |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      TMPFL_SER = AESER == "Y",
      TMPFL_REL = AEREL == "Y",
      TMPFL_GR5 = AETOXGR == "5",
      TMP_SMQ01 = !is.na(SMQ01NAM),
      TMP_SMQ02 = !is.na(SMQ02NAM),
      TMP_CQ01 = !is.na(CQ01NAM)
    ) |>
    teal.data::col_relabel(
      TMPFL_SER = "Serious AE",
      TMPFL_REL = "Related AE",
      TMPFL_GR5 = "Grade 5 AE",
      TMP_SMQ01 = tern::aesi_label(adae$SMQ01NAM, adae$SMQ01SC),
      TMP_SMQ02 = tern::aesi_label(adae$SMQ02NAM, adae$SMQ02SC),
      TMP_CQ01 = tern::aesi_label(adae$CQ01NAM)
    )
}

name: R/run_app.R
content:
#' Run the teal_neue app
#'
#' `teal_neue_app()` builds the teal app: data ([build_teal_neue_data()]),
#' the exploratory, safety and efficacy module groups, module-specific filters
#' (safety modules start on the safety population, efficacy modules on the
#' intent-to-treat population), the header with the dark mode toggle and the
#' teal_neue look (see the "Look and feel" section of [teal_neue_options]).
#' `run_app()` wraps it in a Shiny app object, which starts the app when
#' printed at the console (or when returned from an `app.R` file).
#'
#' @inheritParams load_teal_neue_data
#' @param cache_global Copy every dataset into the Global Environment for easy
#'   console access? `run_app()` defaults to `TRUE`.
#' @return `teal_neue_app()`: a teal app (list with `ui` and `server`).
#'   `run_app()`: a `shiny.appobj`.
#' @seealso [teal_neue_options] for all settings.
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' run_app()
#' run_app(source = "synthetic", synthetic = list(N = 200, seed = 7))
#' run_app(source = "parquet", parquet_dir = "path/to/adam")
#' }
#' @export
run_app <- function(source = getOption("teal_neue.data_source", "bundled"),
                    synthetic = getOption("teal_neue.synthetic", list()),
                    parquet_dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache"),
                    cache_global = getOption("teal_neue.cache_global", TRUE)) {
  app <- teal_neue_app(source, synthetic, parquet_dir, cache_global)
  shiny::shinyApp(teal_neue_fast_ui(app$ui), app$server)
}

#' @rdname run_app
#' @export
teal_neue_app <- function(source = getOption("teal_neue.data_source", "bundled"),
                          synthetic = getOption("teal_neue.synthetic", list()),
                          parquet_dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache"),
                          cache_global = getOption("teal_neue.cache_global", FALSE)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  steps <- character(0)
  tick <- function(what) {
    t1 <- Sys.time()
    steps[[length(steps) + 1L]] <<- sprintf("%s %.2fs", what, as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs")))
    t0 <<- t1
  }
  start <- t0
  style <- teal_neue_style_enabled()
  teal_neue_color_mode() # validate the option before building anything
  teal_neue_set_app_options()

  # The same app, built earlier in this R session with the same settings and
  # data, is reused: a relaunch is instant.
  key <- teal_neue_app_key(source, synthetic, parquet_dir, style)
  cached <- get0("app_cache", envir = the, inherits = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(key) && is.list(cached) && identical(cached$key, key)) {
    if (isTRUE(cache_global)) load_teal_neue_data(source, synthetic, parquet_dir, cache_global = TRUE)
    message(sprintf(
      "[teal_neue] App reused from this R session in %.2fs",
      as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start, units = "secs"))
    ))
    return(cached$app)
  }

  data <- build_teal_neue_data(source, synthetic, parquet_dir, cache_global)
  tick("data")
  modules <- teal_neue_modules(data)
  tick("modules")
  data_label <- teal_neue_data_label(data[[".teal_neue"]]$source, nrow(data[["ADSL"]]))
  index <- if (style) teal_neue_index(modules, overview = teal_neue_app_overview(data, modules))
  tick("overview")

  app <- teal::init(
    data = data,
    filter = teal_neue_filters(modules),
    modules = modules
  ) |>
    teal::modify_title(title = "teal_neue \u00b7 Clinical Trial Analysis", favicon = teal_neue_favicon()) |>
    teal::modify_header(teal_neue_header(data_label, style = style, index = index)) |>
    teal::modify_footer(teal_neue_footer(style = style))
  tick("teal")

  if (!is.null(key)) assign("app_cache", list(key = key, app = app), envir = the)
  message(sprintf(
    "[teal_neue] App built in %.1fs (%s)",
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start, units = "secs")), paste(steps, collapse = ", ")
  ))
  app
}

#' Key of the app cache: everything the app depends on
#'
#' `NULL` (no caching) when option `teal_neue.app_cache` is `FALSE` or a
#' data refresh is requested.
#' @noRd
teal_neue_app_key <- function(source, synthetic, parquet_dir, style) {
  if (!isTRUE(getOption("teal_neue.app_cache", TRUE)) || isTRUE(getOption("teal_neue.refresh_cache", FALSE))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  config <- tryCatch(teal_neue_source_config(source, synthetic, parquet_dir), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(config)) return(NULL)
  rlang::hash(list(
    version = teal_neue_version(),
    data = teal_neue_data_signature(config),
    style = style,
    color_mode = teal_neue_color_mode(),
    motion = teal_neue_motion(),
    ggtheme = teal_neue_ggtheme(),
    ggplot2_args = getOption("teal.ggplot2_args")
  ))
}

#' Serve the app's page from memory
#'
#' teal builds the page (every module's interface) on each browser request.
#' The page does not change between requests, so the first one is kept and
#' served again: reloads and new sessions get the page at once. Requests with
#' a query string (e.g. a bookmark to restore) are always built afresh.
#' @param ui The app's UI: a function of the request, or a tag list.
#' @noRd
teal_neue_fast_ui <- function(ui) {
  if (!is.function(ui) || !isTRUE(getOption("teal_neue.app_cache", TRUE))) return(ui)
  page <- NULL
  function(request) {
    query <- if (is.null(request)) NULL else request$QUERY_STRING
    plain <- is.null(query) || !nzchar(as.character(query))
    if (plain && !is.null(page)) return(page)
    out <- if (length(formals(ui))) ui(request) else ui()
    if (plain) page <<- out
    out
  }
}

name: R/teal.neue-package.R
content:
#' teal.neue: Modernised Clinical Trial Analysis App Built on 'teal'
#'
#' teal_neue combines the exploratory, safety and efficacy teal.gallery
#' templates into a single 'teal' app, backed by a cached data pipeline
#' (ingestion -> pre-processing -> cache) that can read bundled or freshly
#' generated synthetic ADaM data, or ADaM parquet files. Over the standard
#' teal theme it adds an interactive layer (command bar, breadcrumb, deep
#' links, keyboard shortcuts, plot and table tools, pins with visual
#' comparison) and a calm "instrument" look, and its TLG Catalog section
#' reproduces every output of the TLG Catalog on the filtered data.
#'
#' Main entry points:
#' * [run_app()] / [teal_neue_app()]: build and run the app.
#' * [load_teal_neue_data()]: the analysis-ready datasets (cached).

# The teal_data object: datasets + reproducible code + join keys.

#' Build the app's teal_data object
#'
#' Wraps [load_teal_neue_data()] in a `teal_data` object with join keys.
#' `teal_neue_join_keys()` returns the standard CDISC keys for the standard
#' datasets plus explicit keys for the two derived datasets (`ADRS_EFF` and
#' `ADLBPCA`), which are not part of the CDISC defaults.
#'
#' Steps:
#' 1. Run the data pipeline in plain R, so any ingestion or pre-processing
#'    error is raised with a normal traceback (and the cache is filled).
#' 2. Record the reproducible code shown under "Show R code". It calls
#'    `teal.neue::load_teal_neue_data()` with the *resolved* source settings written
#'    out (e.g. the synthetic seed), so it reproduces the same data in a new
#'    session. In the app session it is served from the memory cache.
#' 3. If the recorded code fails, stop with its real error message (teal
#'    returns code errors as a `qenv.error` object instead of raising them).
#'
#' @inheritParams load_teal_neue_data
#' @return `build_teal_neue_data()`: a `teal_data` object with 13 datasets
#'   and join keys. `teal_neue_join_keys()`: a `join_keys` object.
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' data <- build_teal_neue_data(cache_global = FALSE)
#' names(data)
#' teal.data::join_keys(data)
#' }
#' @export
build_teal_neue_data <- function(source = getOption("teal_neue.data_source", "bundled"),
                                 synthetic = getOption("teal_neue.synthetic", list()),
                                 parquet_dir = getOption("teal_neue.parquet_dir", "cache"),
                                 cache_global = getOption("teal_neue.cache_global", FALSE)) {
  # 1. Plain-R pipeline run (errors surface normally); resolves the settings
  config <- teal_neue_source_config(source, synthetic, parquet_dir)
  load_teal_neue_data(config$source, config$synthetic, config$parquet_dir, cache_global = cache_global)

  # 2. Reproducible teal code
  data <- teal.data::teal_data()
  data <- teal.code::eval_code(data, teal_neue_library_code())
  data <- within(
    data,
    {
      .teal_neue <- teal.neue::load_teal_neue_data(
        source = TEAL_NEUE_SOURCE,
        synthetic = TEAL_NEUE_SYNTHETIC,
        parquet_dir = TEAL_NEUE_PARQUET_DIR,
        cache_global = FALSE
      )
      ADSL <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADSL
      ADRS <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADRS
      ADRS_EFF <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADRS_EFF
      ADLB <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADLB
      ADLBPCA <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADLBPCA
      ADTTE <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADTTE
      ADQS <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADQS
      ADAE <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADAE
      ADAETTE <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADAETTE
      ADEX <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADEX
      ADEG <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADEG
      ADVS <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADVS
      ADCM <- .teal_neue$datasets$ADCM
    },
    TEAL_NEUE_SOURCE = config$source,
    TEAL_NEUE_SYNTHETIC = config$synthetic,
    TEAL_NEUE_PARQUET_DIR = config$parquet_dir
  )

  # 3. Surface teal-code errors instead of passing a qenv.error along
  if (inherits(data, "qenv.error")) {
    stop("[teal_neue] The teal data code failed:\n", conditionMessage(data), call. = FALSE)
  }

  teal.data::join_keys(data) <- teal_neue_join_keys()
  data
}

#' @rdname build_teal_neue_data
#' @export
teal_neue_join_keys <- function() {
  c(
    teal.data::default_cdisc_join_keys[c(
      "ADSL", "ADRS", "ADLB", "ADTTE", "ADQS",
      "ADAE", "ADAETTE", "ADEX", "ADEG", "ADVS", "ADCM"
    )],
    teal.data::join_keys(
      # efficacy response subset: same keys as ADRS
      teal.data::join_key("ADRS_EFF", keys = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT")),
      teal.data::join_key("ADSL", "ADRS_EFF", keys = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID")),
      # wide lab data for the PCA module: one row per subject
      teal.data::join_key("ADLBPCA", keys = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID")),
      teal.data::join_key("ADSL", "ADLBPCA", keys = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID"))
    )
  )
}

#' Packages used by the code the analysis modules generate (attached in the
#' teal code so "Show R code" is runnable on its own).
#' NOTE: MASS must be attached *before* dplyr, otherwise MASS::select() masks
#' dplyr::select().
#' @noRd
teal_neue_library_code <- function() {
  pkgs <- c(
    "MASS", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggExtra", "ggpmisc", "ggpp", "goftest", "gridExtra",
    "htmlwidgets", "jsonlite", "lattice", "rlang", "rtables", "nestcolor", "broom",
    "colourpicker", "sparkline"
  )
  paste0("library(", pkgs, ")", collapse = "\n")
}

# TLG Catalog entries: Adverse Events (tables AET*, listings AEL*).
# Code follows the TLG Catalog, adapted to the app's datasets: safety
# population, actual arm (ACTARM), analysis records (ANL01FL == "Y").

#' @noRd

  topic <- "Adverse Events"
  slug <- "adverse-events"
  ae <- c("ADSL", "ADAE")
  list(
    tlg("AET01", "Safety Summary", "Table", topic, slug, data = ae, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adae <- ADAE %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", ANL01FL == "Y") %>%
  mutate(
    FATAL = AESDTH == "Y",
    SER = AESER == "Y",
    SERWD = AESER == "Y" & AEACN == "DRUG WITHDRAWN",
    SERDSM = AESER == "Y" & AEACN %in% c("DRUG INTERRUPTED", "DOSE INCREASED", "DOSE REDUCED"),
    RELSER = AESER == "Y" & AEREL == "Y",
    WD = AEACN == "DRUG WITHDRAWN",
    DSM = AEACN %in% c("DRUG INTERRUPTED", "DOSE INCREASED", "DOSE REDUCED"),
    REL = AEREL == "Y",
    RELWD = AEREL == "Y" & AEACN == "DRUG WITHDRAWN",
    RELDSM = AEREL == "Y" & AEACN %in% c("DRUG INTERRUPTED", "DOSE INCREASED", "DOSE REDUCED"),
    SEV = AESEV == "SEVERE"
  ) %>%
  var_relabel(
    FATAL = "AE with fatal outcome",
    SER = "Serious AE",
    SERWD = "Serious AE leading to withdrawal from treatment",
    SERDSM = "Serious AE leading to dose modification/interruption",
    RELSER = "Related Serious AE",
    WD = "AE leading to withdrawal from treatment",
    DSM = "AE leading to dose modification/interruption",
    REL = "Related AE",
    RELWD = "Related AE leading to withdrawal from treatment",
    RELDSM = "Related AE leading to dose modification/interruption",
    SEV = "Severe AE (at greatest intensity)"
  ) %>%
  df_explicit_na()

aesi_vars <- c("FATAL", "SER", "SERWD", "SERDSM", "RELSER", "WD", "DSM", "REL", "RELWD", "RELDSM", "SEV")

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  add_overall_col(label = "All Patients") %>%
  summarize_num_patients(
    var = "USUBJID",
    .stats = c("unique", "nonunique"),
    .labels = c(
      unique = "Total number of patients with at least one AE",
      nonunique = "Total number of AEs"
    )
  ) %>%
  count_patients_with_flags(
    "USUBJID",
    flag_variables = aesi_vars,
    denom = "N_col",
    var_labels = "Total number of patients with at least one",
    show_labels = "visible"
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adae, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("AET01_AESI", "Safety Summary (Adverse Events of Special Interest)", "Table", topic, slug, data = ae, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adae <- ADAE %>%

  ) %>%
  summarize_num_patients(
    var = "USUBJID",

name: R/tlg_entries_efficacy.R
content:
# TLG Catalog entries: Efficacy (tables, listing, graphs) and Other graphs.
# Efficacy code uses the intent-to-treat population and the planned arm (ARM),
# with placebo ("B: Placebo") as the reference arm. Time-to-event values are
# converted from days to months, as in the catalog.

#' @noRd
tlg_entries_efficacy <- function() {
  topic <- "Efficacy"
  slug <- "efficacy"

  tte_summary <- function(paramcd, label) {
    sprintf(r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %%>%% filter(ITTFL == "Y") %%>%% df_explicit_na()
adtte <- ADTTE %%>%%
  filter(ITTFL == "Y", PARAMCD == "%s") %%>%%
  mutate(
    AVAL = day2month(AVAL),
    is_event = CNSR == 0,
    is_not_event = CNSR == 1
  ) %%>%%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by(var = "ARM", ref_group = "B: Placebo") %%>%%
  analyze_vars(
    "is_event", .stats = "count_fraction",
    .labels = c(count_fraction = "Patients with event (%%)"),
    show_labels = "hidden", table_names = "events"
  ) %%>%%
  analyze_vars(
    "is_not_event", .stats = "count_fraction",
    .labels = c(count_fraction = "Patients without event (%%)"),
    show_labels = "hidden", table_names = "non_events"
  ) %%>%%
  surv_time(vars = "AVAL", var_labels = "%s (Months)", is_event = "is_event", table_names = "time_to_event") %%>%%
  coxph_pairwise(
    vars = "AVAL", is_event = "is_event", var_labels = "Unstratified Analysis",
    control = control_coxph(pval_method = "log-rank"), table_names = "coxph_unstratified"
  ) %%>%%
  coxph_pairwise(
    vars = "AVAL", is_event = "is_event", var_labels = "Stratified Analysis",
    strata = c("STRATA1", "STRATA2"),
    control = control_coxph(pval_method = "log-rank"), table_names = "coxph_stratified"
  ) %%>%%
  surv_timepoint(
    vars = "AVAL", var_labels = "Months", time_point = 12, is_event = "is_event",
    method = "both", control = control_surv_timepoint()
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adtte, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--", paramcd, label)
  }

  ancova_data <- r"--(
adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(ITTFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adqs <- ADQS %>%
  filter(ITTFL == "Y") %>%
  mutate(ARMCD = factor(as.character(ARMCD), levels = c("ARM B", "ARM A", "ARM C"))) %>%
  df_explicit_na()
)--"

  mmrm_fit <- r"--(
adsl <- ADSL %>%
  filter(ITTFL == "Y") %>%
  mutate(ARMCD = factor(as.character(ARMCD), levels = c("ARM B", "ARM A", "ARM C"))) %>%
  df_explicit_na()
adqs <- ADQS %>%
  filter(ITTFL == "Y", PARAMCD == "FKSI-FWB") %>%
  mutate(
    ARMCD = factor(as.character(ARMCD), levels = c("ARM B", "ARM A", "ARM C")),
    AVISIT = droplevels(factor(AVISIT)),
    USUBJID = factor(USUBJID)
  ) %>%
  df_explicit_na()

mmrm_results <- fit_mmrm(
  vars = list(
    response = "AVAL",
    covariates = c("STRATA1", "BMRKR2"),
    id = "USUBJID",
    arm = "ARMCD",
    visit = "AVISIT"
  ),
  data = adqs,
  cor_struct = "unstructured",
  weights_emmeans = "equal"
)
)--"

  rsp_data <- r"--(
adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(ITTFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adrs <- ADRS %>%
  filter(ITTFL == "Y", PARAMCD == "BESRSPI") %>%
  mutate(
    is_rsp = AVALC %in% c("CR", "PR"),
    AVALC = factor(as.character(AVALC), levels = c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD", "NE"))
  ) %>%
  df_explicit_na()
)--"

  list(
    tlg("AOVT01", "ANCOVA for Multiple End Points", "Table", topic, slug, data = c("ADSL", "ADQS"), code = paste0(
      "library(tern)\n", ancova_data, r"--(
adqs_f <- adqs %>% filter(AVISIT == "WEEK 1 DAY 8", PARAMCD %in% c("FKSI-FWB", "FKSI-TSE", "FATIGI"))

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ARMCD", ref_group = "ARM B") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAMCD", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %>%
  summarize_ancova(
    vars = "CHG",
    variables = list(arm = "ARMCD", covariates = NULL),
    conf_level = 0.95,
    var_labels = "Unadjusted comparison",
    .labels = c(lsmean = "Mean", lsmean_diff = "Difference in Means"),
    table_names = "unadjusted"
  ) %>%
  summarize_ancova(
    vars = "CHG",
    variables = list(arm = "ARMCD", covariates = c("BASE", "STRATA1")),
    conf_level = 0.95,
    var_labels = "Adjusted comparison (covariates BASE and STRATA1)",
    table_names = "adjusted"
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adqs_f, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--")),

    tlg("AOVT02", "ANCOVA with Single End Point and Customized Table", "Table", topic, slug, data = c("ADSL", "ADQS"), code = paste0(
      "library(tern)\n", ancova_data, r"--(
adqs_f <- adqs %>% filter(AVISIT == "WEEK 1 DAY 8", PARAMCD == "FKSI-FWB")

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ARMCD", ref_group = "ARM B") %>%
  summarize_ancova(
    vars = "CHG",
    variables = list(arm = "ARMCD", covariates = c("BASE", "STRATA1")),
    conf_level = 0.95,
    var_labels = "FKSI-FWB: change from baseline at week 1",
    .stats = c("n", "lsmean", "lsmean_diff", "lsmean_diff_ci", "pval"),
    .labels = c(
      n = "Number of patients",
      lsmean = "Adjusted mean",
      lsmean_diff = "Difference in adjusted means (vs. ARM B)",
      lsmean_diff_ci = "95% CI",
      pval = "p-value"
    )
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adqs_f, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--")),

    tlg("AOVT03", "ANCOVA with Consideration of Interaction", "Table", topic, slug, data = c("ADSL", "ADQS"), code = paste0(
      "library(tern)\n", ancova_data, r"--(
adqs_f <- adqs %>% filter(AVISIT == "WEEK 1 DAY 8", PARAMCD == "FKSI-FWB")

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ARMCD", ref_group = "ARM B") %>%
  summarize_ancova(
    vars = "CHG",
    variables = list(arm = "ARMCD", covariates = c("BASE", "STRATA1")),
    conf_level = 0.95,
    var_labels = "Without interaction",
    table_names = "main"
  ) %>%
  summarize_ancova(
    vars = "CHG",
    variables = list(arm = "ARMCD", covariates = c("BASE", "STRATA1", "ARMCD*BASE")),
    conf_level = 0.95,
    var_labels = "With treatment-by-baseline interaction",
    table_names = "interaction"
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adqs_f, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--")),

    tlg("CFBT01", "Change from Baseline by Visit Table", "Table", topic, slug, data = c("ADSL", "ADVS"), code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(ITTFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
advs <- ADVS %>%
  filter(ITTFL == "Y", PARAMCD %in% c("DIABP", "SYSBP"), AVISIT != "SCREENING") %>%
  mutate(CHG = ifelse(AVISIT == "BASELINE", NA_real_, CHG)) %>%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ARM") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %>%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Analysis Visit") %>%
  split_cols_by_multivar(vars = c("AVAL", "CHG"), varlabels = c("Value at Visit", "Change from Baseline")) %>%

# TLG Catalog entries: Lab Results (tables LBT*, listings LBL*).
# ADLB in this app has three parameters (ALT, CRP, IGA). The Hy's law outputs
# need ADHY, which is not part of the app's data: they use the
# random.cdisc.data example restricted to the filtered patients.

#' @noRd
tlg_entries_lab <- function() {
  topic <- "Lab Results"
  slug <- "lab-results"
  lb <- c("ADSL", "ADLB")
  adhy_note <- "ADHY is not part of the app's data: uses the random.cdisc.data example, restricted to the filtered patients."

  # Liver (Hy's law) criteria from ADHY: patients meeting each criterion
  hy_patients <- function(baseline, pattern) {
    sprintf(r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %%>%% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %%>%% df_explicit_na()
# ADHY is not part of the app's data: synthetic example data for the same patients
adhy <- teal.neue::tlg_example_data("ADHY", adsl) %%>%% df_explicit_na()

# criteria relative to %s; criteria selected by parameter name
is_baseline <- grepl("baseline", adhy$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE)
keep <- %sis_baseline & grepl("%s", adhy$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (!any(keep)) keep <- %sis_baseline
if (!any(keep)) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(adhy))
liver <- adhy[keep, , drop = FALSE] %%>%%
  mutate(
    PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)),
    MET = toupper(as.character(AVALC)) %%in%% c("Y", "YES", "POSITIVE")
  ) %%>%%
  var_relabel(MET = "Patients meeting the criterion post-baseline")

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by("ARM") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Liver laboratory criterion") %%>%%
  count_patients_with_flags("USUBJID", flag_variables = "MET", denom = "N_col")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = liver, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--",
      if (baseline) "baseline" else "the upper limit of normal (ULN)",
      if (baseline) "" else "!", pattern,
      if (baseline) "" else "!")
  }

  # Liver (Hy's law) criteria from ADHY by visit
  hy_by_visit <- function(baseline) {
    sprintf(r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %%>%% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %%>%% df_explicit_na()
# ADHY is not part of the app's data: synthetic example data for the same patients
adhy <- teal.neue::tlg_example_data("ADHY", adsl) %%>%% df_explicit_na()

is_baseline <- grepl("baseline", adhy$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE)
keep <- %sis_baseline
if (!any(keep)) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(adhy))
liver <- adhy[keep, , drop = FALSE] %%>%%
  mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)), AVALC = droplevels(factor(AVALC)))

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by("ARM") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Liver laboratory criterion") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Visit") %%>%%
  count_occurrences(vars = "AVALC") %%>%%
  append_topleft("    Result")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = liver, alt_counts_df = adsl) %%>%% prune_table()
)--", if (baseline) "" else "!")
  }

  # Time to first Hy's law elevation (ADAETTE)
  hy_tte <- function(paramcd) {
    sprintf(r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %%>%% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %%>%% df_explicit_na()
anl <- ADAETTE %%>%%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", PARAMCD == "%s") %%>%%
  mutate(is_event = CNSR == 0) %%>%%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM", ref_group = "B: Placebo") %%>%%
  analyze_vars(
    "is_event",
    .stats = "count_fraction",
    .labels = c(count_fraction = "Patients meeting Hy's law criteria (%%)"),
    show_labels = "hidden",
    table_names = "events"
  ) %%>%%
  surv_time(vars = "AVAL", var_labels = "Time to first increase", is_event = "is_event", table_names = "time") %%>%%
  coxph_pairwise(
    vars = "AVAL", is_event = "is_event", var_labels = "Unstratified analysis",
    control = control_coxph(pval_method = "log-rank"), table_names = "coxph"
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = anl, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--", paramcd)
  }

  # NCI-CTCAE grade shift: baseline versus worst post-baseline, one direction
  shift <- function(flag, levels, direction) {
    sprintf(r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %%>%% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %%>%% df_explicit_na()
# worst post-baseline record per patient and parameter (%s direction)
adlb <- ADLB %%>%%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", %s == "Y") %%>%%
  mutate(
    BTOXGR = factor(as.character(BTOXGR), levels = c(%s)),
    ATOXGR = factor(as.character(ATOXGR), levels = c(%s))
  ) %%>%%
  var_relabel(BTOXGR = "Baseline NCI-CTCAE grade", ATOXGR = "Worst post-baseline NCI-CTCAE grade") %%>%%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("BTOXGR", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Baseline NCI-CTCAE Grade") %%>%%
  summarize_num_patients(var = "USUBJID", .stats = "unique_count", unique_count_suffix = FALSE) %%>%%
  count_occurrences(vars = "ATOXGR", drop = FALSE) %%>%%
  append_topleft("    Worst Post-Baseline NCI-CTCAE Grade")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--", direction, flag, levels, levels)
  }

  list(
    tlg("LBT01", "Laboratory Test Results and Change from Baseline by Visit", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", AVISIT != "SCREENING") %>%
  mutate(CHG = ifelse(AVISIT == "BASELINE", NA_real_, CHG)) %>%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %>%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Analysis Visit") %>%
  split_cols_by_multivar(vars = c("AVAL", "CHG"), varlabels = c("Value at Visit", "Change from Baseline")) %>%
  summarize_colvars(.stats = c("n", "mean_sd", "median", "range")) %>%
  append_topleft("    Statistics")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("LBT02", "Laboratory Test Results by Visit", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y", AVISIT != "SCREENING") %>% df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %>%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Analysis Visit") %>%
  analyze_vars(vars = "AVAL", .stats = c("n", "mean_sd", "median", "range"), show_labels = "hidden") %>%
  append_topleft("    Statistics")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("LBT03", "Laboratory Test Results Change from Baseline by Visit", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y", AVISIT != "SCREENING") %>% df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %>%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Analysis Visit") %>%
  summarize_change(
    "CHG",
    variables = list(value = "AVAL", baseline_flag = "ABLFL"),
    .stats = c("n", "mean_sd", "median", "range")
  ) %>%
  append_topleft("    Value at baseline / change from baseline")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("LBT04", "Laboratory Abnormalities Not Present at Baseline", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y", ONTRTFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  split_rows_by("LBCAT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Laboratory Category") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Parameter") %>%

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("LBT05", "Laboratory Abnormalities with Single and Replicated Marked", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()

# ADLB has no marked-abnormality category: simulate AVALCAT1 as in the catalog
set.seed(1, kind = "Mersenne-Twister")
adlb <- ADLB %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", ONTRTFL == "Y", ANRIND %in% c("LOW", "HIGH")) %>%
  mutate(
    abn_dir = factor(ifelse(ANRIND == "LOW", "Low", "High"), levels = c("Low", "High")),
    AVALCAT1 = factor(sample(c("LAST", "REPLICATED", "SINGLE"), n(), replace = TRUE),

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%

  split_rows_by("abn_dir", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Direction of Abnormality") %>%
  count_abnormal_by_marked(
    var = "AVALCAT1",
    variables = list(id = "USUBJID", param = "PARAM", direction = "abn_dir")
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--", note = "The marked-abnormality category (AVALCAT1) is simulated, as in the catalog: the example ADLB does not have it."),

    tlg("LBT06", "Laboratory Abnormalities by Visit and Baseline Status", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y", ONTRTFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("LBT07", "Laboratory Test Results with Highest Grade Post-Baseline", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y")

# worst grade in each direction (LOW/HIGH) per patient and parameter
adlb_out <- h_adlb_abnormal_by_worst_grade(adlb) %>%
  filter(GRADE_DIR %in% c("LOW", "HIGH")) %>%
  mutate(
    GRADE_DIR = factor(GRADE_DIR, levels = c("LOW", "HIGH")),

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%

)--"),

    tlg("LBT08", "Laboratory Test Results with Highest Grade Post-Baseline (Worsened from Baseline)", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
# direction of clinical interest per parameter: B = both, L = low, H = high
adlb <- ADLB %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>%
  mutate(GRADDR = case_when(PARAMCD == "ALT" ~ "B", PARAMCD == "CRP" ~ "L", PARAMCD == "IGA" ~ "H")) %>%

df <- h_adlb_worsen(
  adlb,

)

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%

  split_rows_by("GRADDR", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Direction of Abnormality") %>%
  count_abnormal_lab_worsen_by_baseline(

    tlg("LBT09", "Liver Laboratory Tests \u2013 Patients with Elevated Post-Baseline AST or ALT Levels", "Table", topic, slug,

    tlg("LBT10", "Liver Laboratory Tests \u2013 Patients Meeting Hy's Law Criteria (with Respect to ULN)", "Table", topic, slug,

    tlg("LBT10_BL", "Liver Laboratory Tests \u2013 Patients Meeting Hy's Law Criteria (with Respect to Baseline)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADHY", note = adhy_note, code = hy_patients(TRUE, "BILI|Hy")),
    tlg("LBT11", "Time-to-First Increase in Liver Laboratory Test Result Meeting Hy's Law Criteria (with Respect to ULN)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = c("ADSL", "ADAETTE"), code = hy_tte("HYSTTEUL")),
    tlg("LBT11_BL", "Time-to-First Increase in Liver Laboratory Test Result Meeting Hy's Law Criteria (with Respect to Baseline)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = c("ADSL", "ADAETTE"), code = hy_tte("HYSTTEBL")),
    tlg("LBT12", "Liver Laboratory Test Results by Visit (with Respect to ULN)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADHY", note = adhy_note, code = hy_by_visit(FALSE)),
    tlg("LBT12_BL", "Liver Laboratory Test Results by Visit (with Respect to Baseline)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADHY", note = adhy_note, code = hy_by_visit(TRUE)),

    tlg("LBT13", "NCI-CTCAE Grade Laboratory Abnormality Shift Table \u2013 Baseline versus Worst Post-Baseline (High)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = lb, code = shift("WGRHIFL", '"0", "1", "2", "3", "4"', "high")),
    tlg("LBT14", "NCI-CTCAE Grade Laboratory Abnormality Shift Table \u2013 Baseline versus Worst Post-Baseline (Low)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = lb, code = shift("WGRLOFL", '"0", "-1", "-2", "-3", "-4"', "low")),

    tlg("LBT15", "Laboratory Test Shifts to NCI-CTCAE Grade 3-4 Post-Baseline", "Table", topic, slug, data = lb, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adlb <- ADLB %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", ONTRTFL == "Y") %>%
  mutate(
    SHIFT_LOW = BTOXGR %in% c("0", "-1", "-2") & ATOXGR %in% c("-3", "-4"),

  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%

  count_patients_with_flags("USUBJID", flag_variables = c("SHIFT_LOW", "SHIFT_HIGH"), denom = "N_col") %>%
  append_topleft("  Shift")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adlb, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

library(rlistings)

adlb <- ADLB %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", ONTRTFL == "Y", ANRIND %in% c("LOW", "HIGH")) %>%

name: R/tlg_entries_pk_ada.R
content:
# TLG Catalog entries: Pharmacokinetics (PK tables, listings, graphs) and
# Anti-Drug Antibodies (ADA). ADPC, ADPP and ADAB are not part of the app's
# data: the code uses the random.cdisc.data examples restricted to the
# filtered patients (tlg_example_data()). Parameters and specimens are
# selected by name, so the code also adapts to other versions of these data.

#' @noRd
tlg_entries_pk <- function() {
  topic <- "Pharmacokinetics"
  slug <- "pharmacokinetic"
  note <- "ADPC/ADPP are not part of the app's data: uses the random.cdisc.data examples, restricted to the filtered patients."

  pc_setup <- r"--(
adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y")
# ADPC is not part of the app's data: synthetic example data for the same patients
adpc <- teal.neue::tlg_example_data("ADPC", adsl) %>% df_explicit_na()
is_urine <- grepl("urine", adpc$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE)
adpc_plasma <- adpc[!is_urine, , drop = FALSE]
adpc_plasma <- adpc_plasma %>% filter(PARAM == PARAM[1]) %>% mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)))
adpc_urine <- adpc[is_urine, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(adpc_urine)) adpc_urine <- adpc_urine %>% filter(PARAM == PARAM[1]) %>% mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)))
)--"

  pp_setup <- r"--(
adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y")
# ADPP is not part of the app's data: synthetic example data for the same patients
adpp <- teal.neue::tlg_example_data("ADPP", adsl) %>% df_explicit_na()
specimen <- if ("PPSPEC" %in% names(adpp)) as.character(adpp$PPSPEC) else as.character(adpp$PARAM)
adpp_plasma <- adpp[!grepl("urine", specimen, ignore.case = TRUE), , drop = FALSE] %>% mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)))
adpp_urine <- adpp[grepl("urine", specimen, ignore.case = TRUE), , drop = FALSE] %>% mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)))
)--"

  pk_stats <- r"--(.stats = c("n", "mean", "sd", "cv", "geom_mean", "geom_cv", "median", "min", "max"),
    .labels = c(
      n = "n", mean = "Mean", sd = "SD", cv = "CV (%)", geom_mean = "Geometric Mean",
      geom_cv = "CV % Geometric Mean", median = "Median", min = "Minimum", max = "Maximum"
    ))--"

  pp_table <- function(data, rows, stats = pk_stats) {
    split_rows <- paste0(vapply(rows, function(r) {
      sprintf('  split_rows_by("%s", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "%s") %%>%%\n', r[1], r[2])
    }, character(1)), collapse = "")
    paste0("library(tern)\n", pp_setup, sprintf(r"--(
lyt <- basic_table() %%>%%
%s  analyze_vars_in_cols(
    vars = "AVAL",
    %s
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = %s)
)--", split_rows, stats, data))
  }

  list(
    tlg("PKCT01", "Summary Concentration Table", "Table", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note,
        code = paste0("library(tern)\n", pc_setup, sprintf(r"--(
adpc_plasma <- adpc_plasma %%>%% mutate(NFRLT = factor(NFRLT))

lyt <- basic_table() %%>%%
  split_rows_by("ARM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Treatment Group") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("NFRLT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Nominal Time") %%>%%
  analyze_vars_in_cols(
    vars = "AVAL",
    %s
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adpc_plasma)
)--", pk_stats))),

    tlg("PKPT02", "Pharmacokinetic Parameter Summary of Plasma PK Parameters by Treatment", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note,
        code = pp_table("adpp_plasma", list(c("PARAM", "PK Parameter"), c("ARM", "  Treatment Arm")))),
    tlg("PKPT03", "Summary of Plasma Pharmacokinetic Parameters by Treatment Arm", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note,
        code = pp_table("adpp_plasma", list(c("ARM", "Treatment Arm"), c("PARAM", "  PK Parameter")))),
    tlg("PKPT04", "Summary of Urinary Pharmacokinetic Parameters by Treatment Arm", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note,
        code = pp_table("adpp_urine", list(c("ARM", "Treatment Arm"), c("PARAM", "  PK Parameter")))),
    tlg("PKPT05", "Summary of Urinary Pharmacokinetic Parameters by Visit", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note,
        code = pp_table("adpp_urine", list(c("AVISIT", "Visit"), c("PARAM", "  PK Parameter")))),
    tlg("PKPT06", "Summary of Urinary Pharmacokinetic Parameters (Normalized by Dose)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = paste(note, "Dose-normalised parameters are selected by name (containing \"norm\" or \"dose\"); all urinary parameters otherwise."),
        code = sub(
          "result <- build_table(lyt, df = adpp_urine)",
          paste0(
            "adpp_norm <- adpp_urine[grepl(\"norm|dose\", adpp_urine$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]\n",
            "if (!nrow(adpp_norm)) adpp_norm <- adpp_urine\n",
            "result <- build_table(lyt, df = adpp_norm %>% mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM))))"
          ),
          pp_table("adpp_urine", list(c("ARM", "Treatment Arm"), c("PARAM", "  PK Parameter"))),
          fixed = TRUE
        )),
    tlg("PKPT07", "Mean Summary of Urinary Pharmacokinetic Parameters by Treatment Arm", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note,
        code = pp_table("adpp_urine", list(c("PARAM", "PK Parameter"), c("ARM", "  Treatment Arm")),
                        stats = r"--(.stats = c("n", "mean", "sd", "cv"),
    .labels = c(n = "n", mean = "Mean", sd = "SD", cv = "CV (%)"))--")),

    tlg("PKPT08", "Summary of Cumulative Amount of Drug Excreted in Urine", "Table", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note,
        code = paste0("library(tern)\n", pc_setup, sprintf(r"--(
urine <- if (nrow(adpc_urine)) adpc_urine else adpc_plasma
cumulative <- urine %%>%%
  arrange(USUBJID, NFRLT) %%>%%
  group_by(USUBJID) %%>%%
  mutate(AVAL = cumsum(coalesce(AVAL, 0))) %%>%%
  ungroup() %%>%%
  mutate(NFRLT = factor(NFRLT))

lyt <- basic_table() %%>%%
  split_rows_by("ARM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Treatment Group") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("NFRLT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Nominal Time") %%>%%
  analyze_vars_in_cols(
    vars = "AVAL",
    %s
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = cumulative)
)--", pk_stats))),

    tlg("PKPT11", "Summary of Pharmacokinetic Parameter Estimates (Geometric Means for Ratios)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note,
        code = pp_table("adpp_plasma", list(c("PARAM", "PK Parameter"), c("ARM", "  Treatment Arm")),
                        stats = r"--(.stats = c("n", "geom_mean", "geom_cv", "geom_mean_ci"),
    .labels = c(n = "n", geom_mean = "Geometric Mean", geom_cv = "CV % Geometric Mean", geom_mean_ci = "95% CI"))--")),

    tlg("PKCL01", "Listing of Drug Concentration by Treatment Group, Patient and Nominal Time", "Listing", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", pc_setup, r"--(
out <- adpc_plasma %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "NFRLT", "AFRLT", "AVAL", "AVALU"))) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID, NFRLT) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID", AVAL = paste("Concentration:", adpc_plasma$PARAM[1]))

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--")),

    tlg("PKCL02", "Listing of Drug Urine Concentration and Volumes", "Listing", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", pc_setup, r"--(
urine <- if (nrow(adpc_urine)) adpc_urine else adpc_plasma
out <- urine %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "NFRLT", "AFRLT", "PARAM", "AVAL", "AVALU"))) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID, NFRLT) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID")

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--")),

    tlg("PKPL01", "Listing of Drug Plasma PK Parameters", "Listing", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
out <- adpp_plasma %>%
  mutate(AVAL = round(AVAL, 3)) %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "PARAM", "AVAL", "AVALU"))) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID, PARAM) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID", PARAM = "PK Parameter", AVAL = "Value")

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--")),

    tlg("PKPL02", "Listing of Drug Urine PK Parameters", "Listing", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
urine <- if (nrow(adpp_urine)) adpp_urine else adpp_plasma
out <- urine %>%
  mutate(AVAL = round(AVAL, 3)) %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "PARAM", "AVAL", "AVALU"))) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID, PARAM) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID", PARAM = "PK Parameter", AVAL = "Value")

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--")),

    tlg("PKPL04", "Listing of Individual AUC and Cmax Values", "Listing", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
# one column per exposure parameter (AUC and Cmax), one row per patient and visit
out <- adpp_plasma %>%
  filter(grepl("^AUC|^CMAX", PARAMCD, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(AVAL = round(AVAL, 3), PARAMCD = as.character(PARAMCD)) %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "PARAMCD", "AVAL"))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = PARAMCD, values_from = AVAL, values_fn = dplyr::first) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID")

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--")),

    tlg("PKCG01", "Plot of PK Concentration Over Time by Subject", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note,
        code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pc_setup, r"--(
result <- ggplot(adpc_plasma, aes(x = NFRLT, y = AVAL, group = USUBJID, colour = ARM)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Individual concentration over time:", adpc_plasma$PARAM[1]),
    x = "Nominal time (hr)", y = paste0("Concentration (", adpc_plasma$AVALU[1], ")"), colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
)--")),

    tlg("PKCG02", "Plot of PK Concentration Over Time by Cohort/Treatment Group/Dose", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note,
        height = 620L, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pc_setup, r"--(
result <- ggplot(adpc_plasma, aes(x = NFRLT, y = AVAL, group = USUBJID)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#0a84ff", alpha = 0.35) +
  facet_wrap(~ARM) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Concentration over time by treatment group (log scale):", adpc_plasma$PARAM[1]),
    x = "Nominal time (hr)", y = paste0("Concentration (", adpc_plasma$AVALU[1], ")")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
)--")),

    tlg("PKCG03", "Plot of Mean PK Concentration Over Time by Cohort", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note,
        code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pc_setup, r"--(
means <- adpc_plasma %>%
  group_by(ARM, NFRLT) %>%
  summarise(MEAN = mean(AVAL, na.rm = TRUE), SD = sd(AVAL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

result <- ggplot(means, aes(x = NFRLT, y = MEAN, colour = ARM)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MEAN - SD, ymax = MEAN + SD), width = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Mean (\u00b1 SD) concentration over time:", adpc_plasma$PARAM[1]),
    x = "Nominal time (hr)", y = paste0("Concentration (", adpc_plasma$AVALU[1], ")"), colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
)--")),

    tlg("PKPG01", "Plot of Mean Cumulative Percentage (%) of Recovered Drug in Urine", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPC", note = note,
        code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pc_setup, r"--(
urine <- if (nrow(adpc_urine)) adpc_urine else adpc_plasma
recovered <- urine %>%
  arrange(USUBJID, NFRLT) %>%
  group_by(USUBJID) %>%
  mutate(PCT = 100 * cumsum(coalesce(AVAL, 0)) / sum(AVAL, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(ARM, NFRLT) %>%
  summarise(PCT = mean(PCT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

result <- ggplot(recovered, aes(x = NFRLT, y = PCT, colour = ARM)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean cumulative percentage of recovered drug",
    x = "Nominal time (hr)", y = "Cumulative recovered (%)", colour = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
)--")),

    tlg("PKPG02", "Pharmacokinetic Parameter Summary of Plasma PK Parameters by Treatment Arm", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP",
        note = note, height = 620L, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
result <- ggplot(adpp_plasma, aes(x = ARM, y = AVAL, fill = ARM)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~PARAM, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Plasma PK parameters by treatment arm", x = NULL, y = "Value", fill = "Treatment") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
)--")),

    tlg("PKPG03", "Box Plot of Pharmacokinetic Parameters by Visit - Plasma", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP",
        note = note, height = 620L, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
result <- ggplot(adpp_plasma, aes(x = AVISIT, y = AVAL, fill = ARM)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~PARAM, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Plasma PK parameters by visit", x = "Visit", y = "Value", fill = "Treatment") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)--")),

    tlg("PKPG04", "Bar Chart of Pharmacokinetic Parameters", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP",
        note = note, height = 620L, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
means <- adpp_plasma %>%
  group_by(PARAM, ARM) %>%
  summarise(MEAN = mean(AVAL, na.rm = TRUE), SD = sd(AVAL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

result <- ggplot(means, aes(x = ARM, y = MEAN, fill = ARM)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MEAN, ymax = MEAN + SD), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~PARAM, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Mean (+ SD) plasma PK parameters", x = NULL, y = "Mean", fill = "Treatment") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
)--")),

    tlg("PKPG06", "Box Plot of Pharmacokinetic Parameters by Visit - Urine", "Graph", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADPP",
        note = note, height = 620L, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n", pp_setup, r"--(
urine <- if (nrow(adpp_urine)) adpp_urine else adpp_plasma
result <- ggplot(urine, aes(x = AVISIT, y = AVAL, fill = ARM)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~PARAM, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Urinary PK parameters by visit", x = "Visit", y = "Value", fill = "Treatment") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)--"))
  )
}

#' @noRd
tlg_entries_ada <- function() {
  topic <- "Anti-Drug Antibodies"
  slug <- "ADA"
  note <- "ADAB is not part of the app's data: uses the random.cdisc.data example, restricted to the filtered patients; parameters are selected by name."

  ab_setup <- r"--(
adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
# ADAB is not part of the app's data: synthetic example data for the same patients
adab <- teal.neue::tlg_example_data("ADAB", adsl) %>% df_explicit_na()
)--"

  # patient-level ADA results whose parameter name matches `pattern`
  ada_table <- function(pattern, label) {
    paste0("library(tern)\n", ab_setup, sprintf(r"--(
keep <- grepl("%s", adab$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (!any(keep)) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(adab))
anl <- adab[keep, , drop = FALSE] %%>%%
  mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)), AVALC = droplevels(factor(AVALC))) %%>%%
  group_by(USUBJID, PARAM) %%>%%
  slice(1) %%>%%
  ungroup()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by("ARM") %%>%%
  add_overall_col(label = "All Patients") %%>%%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "%s") %%>%%
  count_occurrences(vars = "AVALC") %%>%%
  append_topleft("  Result")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = anl, alt_counts_df = adsl) %%>%% prune_table()
)--", pattern, label))
  }

  list(
    tlg("ADAT01", "Baseline Prevalence and Incidence of Treatment Emergent ADA", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADAB", note = note, code = ada_table("baseline|emergent|incidence|prevalence", "ADA parameter")),
    tlg("ADAT02", "Summary of Patients with Treatment-Induced ADA", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADAB", note = note, code = ada_table("induced|enhanced|persistent|transient", "ADA parameter")),

    tlg("ADAT03", "Summary of Serum Concentrations at Timepoints Where ADA Samples Were Collected and Analyzed", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = c("ADAB", "ADPC"), note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\n", ab_setup, r"--(
adpc <- teal.neue::tlg_example_data("ADPC", adsl) %>% df_explicit_na()
adpc <- adpc[!grepl("urine", adpc$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE), , drop = FALSE] %>% filter(PARAM == PARAM[1])

# concentrations at the visits with an ADA sample
ada_visits <- adab %>% distinct(USUBJID, AVISIT) %>% mutate(AVISIT = as.character(AVISIT))
anl <- adpc %>%
  mutate(AVISIT = as.character(AVISIT)) %>%
  semi_join(ada_visits, by = c("USUBJID", "AVISIT")) %>%
  mutate(AVISIT = factor(AVISIT))
if (!nrow(anl)) anl <- adpc %>% mutate(AVISIT = factor(AVISIT))

lyt <- basic_table() %>%
  split_rows_by("ARM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Treatment Group") %>%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Visit") %>%
  analyze_vars_in_cols(
    vars = "AVAL",
    .stats = c("n", "mean", "sd", "median", "min", "max", "cv", "geom_mean"),
    .labels = c(
      n = "n", mean = "Mean", sd = "SD", median = "Median", min = "Minimum", max = "Maximum",
      cv = "CV (%)", geom_mean = "Geometric Mean"
    )
  )

result <- build_table(lyt, df = anl)
)--")),

    tlg("ADAT04A", "Baseline Prevalence and Incidence of Treatment Emergent Neutralizing Antibodies", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADAB", note = note, code = ada_table("neutraliz|NAb", "Neutralizing antibody parameter")),
    tlg("ADAT04B", "Baseline Prevalence and Incidence of Treatment Emergent Neutralizing Antibodies (by Visit)", "Table", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADAB", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\n", ab_setup, r"--(
keep <- grepl("neutraliz|NAb", adab$PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (!any(keep)) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(adab))
anl <- adab[keep, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(PARAM = droplevels(factor(PARAM)), AVALC = droplevels(factor(AVALC)), AVISIT = droplevels(factor(AVISIT)))

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ARM") %>%
  split_rows_by("PARAM", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "Parameter") %>%
  split_rows_by("AVISIT", split_fun = drop_split_levels, label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "  Visit") %>%
  count_occurrences(vars = "AVALC") %>%
  append_topleft("    Result")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = anl, alt_counts_df = adsl) %>% prune_table()
)--")),

    tlg("ADAL01", "Listing of Anti-Drug Antibody Data", "Listing", topic, slug, data = "ADSL", extra = "ADAB", note = note,
        code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", ab_setup, r"--(
out <- adab %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "PARAM", "AVALC", "AVAL", "AVALU"))) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID")

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--")),

    tlg("ADAL02", "Listing of Anti-Drug Antibody Data for Treatment Emergent ADA Positive Patients", "Listing", topic, slug,
        data = "ADSL", extra = "ADAB", note = note, code = paste0("library(tern)\nlibrary(rlistings)\n", ab_setup, r"--(
# patients with a positive treatment-emergent ADA result
positive <- adab %>%
  filter(
    grepl("emergent", PARAM, ignore.case = TRUE),
    toupper(as.character(AVALC)) %in% c("Y", "YES", "POSITIVE")
  ) %>%
  distinct(USUBJID)
anl <- if (nrow(positive)) semi_join(adab, positive, by = "USUBJID") else adab

out <- anl %>%
  select(any_of(c("ARM", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "PARAM", "AVALC", "AVAL", "AVALU"))) %>%
  arrange(ARM, USUBJID) %>%
  var_relabel(ARM = "Treatment Group", USUBJID = "Patient ID")

result <- as_listing(out, key_cols = c("ARM", "USUBJID"), disp_cols = names(out))
)--"))
  )
}

name: R/tlg_entries_safety.R
content:
# TLG Catalog entries: Concomitant Medications, Deaths, Demography,
# Disclosures, Disposition, ECG, Exposure, Risk Management Plan, Medical
# History and Vital Signs. Code follows the TLG Catalog, adapted to the app's
# datasets (safety population and actual arm unless stated otherwise).

#' @noRd
tlg_entries_conmed <- function() {
  topic <- "Concomitant Medications"
  slug <- "concomitant-medications"
  cm <- c("ADSL", "ADCM")

  cm_table <- function(class_var, class_label) {
    sprintf(r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %%>%% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %%>%% df_explicit_na()
adcm <- ADCM %%>%% filter(SAFFL == "Y", ATIREL == "CONCOMITANT") %%>%% df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %%>%%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %%>%%
  add_overall_col(label = "All Patients") %%>%%
  summarize_num_patients(
    var = "USUBJID",
    .stats = c("unique", "nonunique"),
    .labels = c(
      unique = "Total number of patients with at least one treatment",
      nonunique = "Total number of treatments"
    )
  ) %%>%%
  split_rows_by(
    "%s",
    child_labels = "visible", nested = FALSE, split_fun = drop_split_levels,
    label_pos = "topleft", split_label = "%s"
  ) %%>%%
  summarize_num_patients(
    var = "USUBJID",
    .stats = c("unique", "nonunique"),
    .labels = c(
      unique = "Total number of patients with at least one treatment",
      nonunique = "Total number of treatments"
    )
  ) %%>%%
  count_occurrences(vars = "CMDECOD", .indent_mods = -1L) %%>%%
  append_topleft("  Other Treatment")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adcm, alt_counts_df = adsl) %%>%%
  prune_table() %%>%%
  sort_at_path(path = "%s", scorefun = cont_n_allcols) %%>%%
  sort_at_path(path = c("%s", "*", "CMDECOD"), scorefun = score_occurrences)
)--", class_var, class_label, class_var, class_var)
  }

  list(
    tlg("CMT01", "Concomitant Medications (GNEDrug Legacy Dictionary)", "Table", topic, slug, data = cm,
        code = cm_table("CMCLAS", "Medication Class")),
    tlg("CMT01A", "Concomitant Medications by Medication Class and Preferred Name", "Table", topic, slug, data = cm,
        code = cm_table("ATC2", "ATC Class Level 2")),
    tlg("CMT01B", "Concomitant Medications by Medication Class and Preferred Name (ATC Level 1)", "Table", topic, slug, data = cm,
        code = cm_table("ATC1", "ATC Class Level 1")),

    tlg("CMT02_PT", "Concomitant Medications by Preferred Name", "Table", topic, slug, data = cm, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adcm <- ADCM %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y", ATIREL == "CONCOMITANT") %>% df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  add_overall_col(label = "All Patients") %>%
  summarize_num_patients(
    var = "USUBJID",
    .stats = c("unique", "nonunique"),
    .labels = c(
      unique = "Total number of patients with at least one treatment",
      nonunique = "Total number of treatments"
    )
  ) %>%
  count_occurrences(vars = "CMDECOD") %>%
  append_topleft("Other Treatment")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adcm, alt_counts_df = adsl) %>%

    tlg("RMPT01", "Duration of Exposure for Risk Management Plan", "Table", "Risk Management Plan", "risk-management-plan",
        data = ex, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adex <- ADEX %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", PARAMCD == "TDURD") %>%
  mutate(
    AVALCAT1 = cut(AVAL, breaks = c(0, 30, 90, 180, Inf), right = FALSE,
                   labels = c("< 1 month", "1 to <3 months", "3 to <6 months", ">=6 months"))
  ) %>%
  var_relabel(AVALCAT1 = "Duration of exposure") %>%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE, main_footer = "* Patient time is the sum of exposure across all patients in days.") %>%
  analyze_patients_exposure_in_cols(
    var = "AVALCAT1",
    col_split = TRUE,
    add_total_level = TRUE,
    custom_label = "Total patients number/person time*"
  ) %>%
  append_topleft(c("", "Duration of exposure"))

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adex, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("RMPT03", "Extent of Exposure by Age Group and Gender for Risk Management Plan", "Table", "Risk Management Plan",
        "risk-management-plan", data = ex, code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y") %>% df_explicit_na()
adex <- ADEX %>%
  filter(SAFFL == "Y", PARAMCD == "TDURD") %>%
  mutate(
    AGEGR = cut(AGE, breaks = c(0, 18, 65, Inf), right = FALSE, labels = c("<18", "18 - 64", ">=65")),
    SEX = droplevels(factor(SEX))
  ) %>%
  var_relabel(AGEGR = "Age group (years)") %>%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE, main_footer = "* Patient time is the sum of exposure across all patients in days.") %>%
  split_cols_by("SEX", split_fun = add_overall_level("Total", first = FALSE)) %>%
  analyze_patients_exposure_in_cols(
    var = "AGEGR",
    col_split = TRUE,
    add_total_level = TRUE,
    custom_label = "Total patients number/person time*"
  ) %>%
  append_topleft(c("", "Age group (years)"))

result <- build_table(lyt, df = adex, alt_counts_df = adsl)
)--"),

    tlg("RMPT04", "Extent of Exposure by Ethnic Origin for Risk Management Plan", "Table", "Risk Management Plan",
        "risk-management-plan", data = ex, code = rmp_by("ETHNIC", "Ethnicity")),

    tlg("RMPT05", "Extent of Exposure by Race for Risk Management Plan", "Table", "Risk Management Plan",
        "risk-management-plan", data = ex, code = rmp_by("RACE", "Race")),

    tlg("RMPT06", "Seriousness, Outcomes, Severity, Frequency with 95% CI for Risk Management Plan", "Table",
        "Risk Management Plan", "risk-management-plan", data = c("ADSL", "ADAE"), code = r"--(
library(tern)

adsl <- ADSL %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y")
adae <- ADAE %>% filter(SAFFL == "Y", ANL01FL == "Y")

# one record per patient with AE flags (patients without AE: FALSE)
ae_flags <- adae %>%
  group_by(USUBJID) %>%
  summarise(
    ANY = TRUE,
    SER = any(AESER == "Y"),
    FATAL = any(AESDTH == "Y"),
    RESOLVED = all(AEOUT %in% c("RECOVERED/RESOLVED", "RECOVERED/RESOLVED WITH SEQUELAE")),
    WORSTGR = max(as.integer(as.character(AETOXGR)), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
anl <- adsl %>%
  left_join(ae_flags, by = "USUBJID") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(ANY, SER, FATAL), ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)),
    RESOLVED = coalesce(ANY & RESOLVED, FALSE),
    WORSTGR = factor(WORSTGR, levels = 1:5, labels = paste("Grade", 1:5))
  ) %>%
  df_explicit_na()

lyt <- basic_table(show_colcounts = TRUE) %>%
  split_cols_by("ACTARM") %>%
  add_overall_col(label = "All Patients") %>%
  estimate_proportion(vars = "ANY", method = "clopper-pearson", table_names = "any",
                      .labels = c(n_prop = "Patients with at least one AE")) %>%
  estimate_proportion(vars = "SER", method = "clopper-pearson", table_names = "ser",
                      .labels = c(n_prop = "Patients with at least one serious AE")) %>%
  estimate_proportion(vars = "FATAL", method = "clopper-pearson", table_names = "fatal",
                      .labels = c(n_prop = "Patients with at least one fatal AE")) %>%
  estimate_proportion(vars = "RESOLVED", method = "clopper-pearson", table_names = "resolved",
                      .labels = c(n_prop = "Patients with all AEs resolved")) %>%
  analyze_vars("WORSTGR", var_labels = "Highest NCI CTCAE grade", .stats = "count_fraction", show_labels = "visible")

result <- build_table(lyt, df = anl)
)--", note = "Any AE; seriousness, outcome and severity, each with a 95% Clopper-Pearson confidence interval.")
  )
}

#' @noRd
tlg_entries_medical_history <- function() {
  topic <- "Medical History"
  list(
